1.zh: 扫罗死后，大卫击杀亚玛力人回来，在洗革拉住了两天。
1.en: After the death of Saul, when David had returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites, and David had stayed two days in Ziklag,

1.zh: 第三天，有一人从扫罗的营里出来，衣服撕裂，头蒙灰尘，到大卫面前伏地叩拜。
1.en: on the third day, behold, a man came out of the camp from Saul, with his clothes torn and earth on his head. When he came to David, he fell to the earth and showed respect.

1.zh: 大卫问他说：「你从哪里来？」他说：「我从以色列的营里逃来。」
1.en: David said to him, “Where do you come from?” He said to him, “I have escaped out of the camp of Israel.”

1.zh: 大卫又问他说：「事情怎样？请你告诉我。」他回答说：「百姓从阵上逃跑，也有许多人仆倒死亡；扫罗和他儿子约拿单也死了。」
1.en: David said to him, “How did it go? Please tell me.” He answered, “The people have fled from the battle, and many of the people also have fallen and are dead. Saul and Jonathan his son are dead also.”

1.zh: 大卫问报信的少年人说：「你怎么知道扫罗和他儿子约拿单死了呢？」
1.en: David said to the young man who told him, “How do you know that Saul and Jonathan his son are dead?”

1.zh: 报信的少年人说：「我偶然到基利波山，看见扫罗伏在自己枪上，有战车、马兵紧紧地追他。
1.en: The young man who told him said, “As I happened by chance on Mount Gilboa, behold, Saul was leaning on his spear; and behold, the chariots and the horsemen followed close behind him.

1.zh: 他回头看见我，就呼叫我。我说：『我在这里。』
1.en: When he looked behind him, he saw me and called to me. I answered, ‘Here I am.’

1.zh: 他问我说：『你是什么人？』我说：『我是亚玛力人。』
1.en: He said to me, ‘Who are you?’ I answered him, ‘I am an Amalekite.’

1.zh: 他说：『请你来，将我杀死；因为痛苦抓住我，我的生命尚存。』
1.en: He said to me, ‘Please stand beside me, and kill me, for anguish has taken hold of me because my life lingers in me.’

1.zh: 我准知他仆倒必不能活，就去将他杀死，把他头上的冠冕、臂上的镯子拿到我主这里。」
1.en: So I stood beside him and killed him, because I was sure that he could not live after he had fallen. I took the crown that was on his head and the bracelet that was on his arm, and have brought them here to my lord.”

1.zh: 大卫就撕裂衣服，跟随他的人也是如此，
1.en: Then David took hold of his clothes and tore them; and all the men who were with him did likewise.

1.zh: 而且悲哀哭号，禁食到晚上，是因扫罗和他儿子约拿单，并耶和华的民以色列家的人，倒在刀下。
1.en: They mourned, wept, and fasted until evening for Saul and for Jonathan his son, and for the people of the LORD, and for the house of Israel, because they had fallen by the sword.

1.zh: 大卫问报信的少年人说：「你是哪里的人？」他说：「我是亚玛力客人的儿子。」
1.en: David said to the young man who told him, “Where are you from?” He answered, “I am the son of a foreigner, an Amalekite.”

1.zh: 大卫说：「你伸手杀害耶和华的受膏者，怎么不畏惧呢？」
1.en: David said to him, “Why were you not afraid to stretch out your hand to destroy the LORD’s anointed?”

1.zh: 大卫叫了一个少年人来，说：「你去杀他吧！」
1.en: David called one of the young men and said, “Go near, and cut him down!” He struck him so that he died.

1.zh: 大卫对他说：「你流人血的罪归到自己的头上，因为你亲口作见证说：『我杀了耶和华的受膏者。』」少年人就把他杀了。
1.en: David said to him, “Your blood be on your head, for your mouth has testified against you, saying, ‘I have slain the LORD’s anointed.’”

1.zh: 大卫作哀歌，吊扫罗和他儿子约拿单，
1.en: David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over Jonathan his son

1.zh: 且吩咐将这歌教导犹大人。这歌名叫「弓歌」，写在雅煞珥书上。
1.en: (and he commanded them to teach the children of Judah the song of the bow; behold, it is written in the book of Jashar):

1.zh: [歌中说]：以色列啊， 你尊荣者在山上被杀！ 大英雄何竟死亡！
1.en: “Your glory, Israel, was slain on your high places! How the mighty have fallen!

1.zh: 不要在迦特报告； 不要在亚实基伦街上传扬； 免得非利士的女子欢乐； 免得未受割礼之人的女子矜夸。
1.en: Don’t tell it in Gath. Don’t publish it in the streets of Ashkelon, lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice, lest the daughters of the uncircumcised triumph.

1.zh: 基利波山哪，愿你那里没有雨露！ 愿你田地无土产可作供物！ 因为英雄的盾牌在那里被污丢弃； 扫罗的盾牌仿佛未曾抹油。
1.en: You mountains of Gilboa, let there be no dew or rain on you, and no fields of offerings; for there the shield of the mighty was defiled and cast away, the shield of Saul was not anointed with oil.

1.zh: 约拿单的弓箭非流敌人的血不退缩； 扫罗的刀剑非剖勇士的油不收回。
1.en: From the blood of the slain, from the fat of the mighty, Jonathan’s bow didn’t turn back. Saul’s sword didn’t return empty.

1.zh: 扫罗和约拿单— 活时相悦相爱，死时也不分离 —他们比鹰更快，比狮子还强。
1.en: Saul and Jonathan were lovely and pleasant in their lives. In their death, they were not divided. They were swifter than eagles. They were stronger than lions.

1.zh: 以色列的女子啊，当为扫罗哭号！ 他曾使你们穿朱红色的美衣， 使你们衣服有黄金的妆饰。
1.en: You daughters of Israel, weep over Saul, who clothed you delicately in scarlet, who put ornaments of gold on your clothing.

1.zh: 英雄何竟在阵上仆倒！ 约拿单何竟在山上被杀！
1.en: How the mighty have fallen in the middle of the battle! Jonathan was slain on your high places.

1.zh: 我兄约拿单哪，我为你悲伤！ 我甚喜悦你！ 你向我发的爱情奇妙非常， 过于妇女的爱情。
1.en: I am distressed for you, my brother Jonathan. You have been very pleasant to me. Your love to me was wonderful, surpassing the love of women.

1.zh: 英雄何竟仆倒！ 战具何竟灭没！
1.en: How the mighty have fallen, and the weapons of war have perished!”

2.zh: 此后，大卫问耶和华说：「我上犹大的一个城去可以吗？」耶和华说：「可以。」大卫说：「我上哪一个城去呢？」耶和华说：「上希伯 去。」
2.en: After this, David inquired of the LORD, saying, “Shall I go up into any of the cities of Judah?” The LORD said to him, “Go up.” David said, “Where shall I go up?” He said, “To Hebron.”

2.zh: 于是大卫和他的两个妻—一个是耶斯列人亚希暖，一个是作过迦密人拿八妻的亚比该—都上那里去了。
2.en: So David went up there with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.

2.zh: 大卫也将跟随他的人和他们各人的眷属一同带上去，住在希伯 的城邑中。
2.en: David brought up his men who were with him, every man with his household. They lived in the cities of Hebron.

2.zh: 犹大人来到希伯 ，在那里膏大卫作犹大家的王。 有人告诉大卫说：「葬埋扫罗的是基列·雅比人。」
2.en: The men of Judah came, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah. They told David, “The men of Jabesh Gilead were those who buried Saul.”

2.zh: 大卫就差人去见基列·雅比人，对他们说：「你们厚待你们的主—扫罗，将他葬埋。愿耶和华赐福与你们！
2.en: David sent messengers to the men of Jabesh Gilead, and said to them, “Blessed are you by the LORD, that you have shown this kindness to your lord, even to Saul, and have buried him.

2.zh: 你们既行了这事，愿耶和华以慈爱诚实待你们，我也要为此厚待你们。
2.en: Now may the LORD show loving kindness and truth to you. I also will reward you for this kindness, because you have done this thing.

2.zh: 现在你们的主—扫罗死了，犹大家已经膏我作他们的王，所以你们要刚强奋勇。」
2.en: Now therefore let your hands be strong, and be valiant; for Saul your lord is dead, and also the house of Judah have anointed me king over them.”

2.zh: 扫罗的元帅尼珥的儿子押尼珥，曾将扫罗的儿子伊施波设带过[河]，到玛哈念，
2.en: Now Abner the son of Ner, captain of Saul’s army, had taken Ishbosheth the son of Saul and brought him over to Mahanaim.

2.zh: 立他作王，治理基列、亚书利、耶斯列、以法莲、便雅悯，和以色列众人。
2.en: He made him king over Gilead, over the Ashurites, over Jezreel, over Ephraim, over Benjamin, and over all Israel.

2.zh: 扫罗的儿子伊施波设登基的时候年四十岁，作以色列王二年；惟独犹大家归从大卫。
2.en: Ishbosheth, Saul’s son, was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel, and he reigned two years. But the house of Judah followed David.

2.zh: 大卫在希伯 作犹大家的王，共七年零六个月。
2.en: The time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months.

2.zh: 尼珥的儿子押尼珥和扫罗的儿子伊施波设的仆人从玛哈念出来，往基遍去。
2.en: Abner the son of Ner, and the servants of Ishbosheth the son of Saul, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.

2.zh: 洗鲁雅的儿子约押和大卫的仆人也出来，在基遍池旁与他们相遇；一班坐在池这边，一班坐在池那边。
2.en: Joab the son of Zeruiah and David’s servants went out, and met them by the pool of Gibeon; and they sat down, the one on the one side of the pool and the other on the other side of the pool.

2.zh: 押尼珥对约押说：「让少年人起来，在我们面前戏耍吧！」约押说：「可以。」
2.en: Abner said to Joab, “Please let the young men arise and compete before us!” Joab said, “Let them arise!”

2.zh: 就按着定数起来：属扫罗儿子伊施波设的便雅悯人过去十二名，大卫的仆人也过去十二名，
2.en: Then they arose and went over by number: twelve for Benjamin and for Ishbosheth the son of Saul, and twelve of David’s servants.

2.zh: 彼此揪头，用刀刺肋，一同仆倒。所以，那地叫做希利甲·哈素林，就在基遍。
2.en: They each caught his opponent by the head and thrust his sword in his fellow’s side; so they fell down together. Therefore that place in Gibeon was called Helkath Hazzurim.

2.zh: 那日的战事凶猛，押尼珥和以色列人败在大卫的仆人面前。
2.en: The battle was very severe that day; and Abner was beaten, and the men of Israel, before David’s servants.

2.zh: 在那里有洗鲁雅的三个儿子：约押、亚比筛、亚撒黑。亚撒黑脚快如野鹿一般；
2.en: The three sons of Zeruiah were there: Joab, Abishai, and Asahel. Asahel was as light of foot as a wild gazelle.

2.zh: 亚撒黑追赶押尼珥，直追赶他不偏左右。
2.en: Asahel pursued Abner. He didn’t turn to the right hand or to the left from following Abner.

2.zh: 押尼珥回头说：「你是亚撒黑吗？」回答说：「是。」
2.en: Then Abner looked behind him and said, “Is that you, Asahel?” He answered, “It is.”

2.zh: 押尼珥对他说：「你或转向左转向右，拿住一个少年人，剥去他的战衣。」亚撒黑却不肯转开不追赶他。
2.en: Abner said to him, “Turn away to your right hand or to your left, and grab one of the young men, and take his armor.” But Asahel would not turn away from following him.

2.zh: 押尼珥又对亚撒黑说：「你转开不追赶我吧！我何必杀你呢？若杀你，有什么脸见你哥哥约押呢？」
2.en: Abner said again to Asahel, “Turn away from following me. Why should I strike you to the ground? How then could I look Joab your brother in the face?”

2.zh: 亚撒黑仍不肯转开。故此，押尼珥就用枪 刺入他的肚腹，甚至枪从背后透出，亚撒黑就在那里仆倒而死。众人赶到亚撒黑仆倒而死的地方，就都站住。
2.en: However, he refused to turn away. Therefore Abner with the back end of the spear struck him in the body, so that the spear came out behind him; and he fell down there and died in the same place. As many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died stood still.

2.zh: 约押和亚比筛追赶押尼珥，日落的时候，到了通基遍旷野的路旁，基亚对面的亚玛山。
2.en: But Joab and Abishai pursued Abner. The sun went down when they had come to the hill of Ammah, that lies before Giah by the way of the wilderness of Gibeon.

2.zh: 便雅悯人聚集，跟随押尼珥站在一个山顶上。
2.en: The children of Benjamin gathered themselves together after Abner and became one band, and stood on the top of a hill.

2.zh: 押尼珥呼叫约押说：「刀剑岂可永远杀人吗？你岂不知终久必有苦楚吗？你要等何时才叫百姓回去、不追赶弟兄呢？」
2.en: Then Abner called to Joab, and said, “Shall the sword devour forever? Don’t you know that it will be bitterness in the latter end? How long will it be then, before you ask the people to return from following their brothers?”

2.zh: 约押说：「我指着永生的　神起誓：你若不说[戏耍的]那句话，今日早晨百姓就回去，不追赶弟兄了。」
2.en: Joab said, “As God lives, if you had not spoken, surely then in the morning the people would have gone away, and not each followed his brother.”

2.zh: 于是约押吹角，众民就站住，不再追赶以色列人，也不再打仗了。
2.en: So Joab blew the trumpet; and all the people stood still and pursued Israel no more, and they fought no more.

2.zh: 押尼珥和跟随他的人整夜经过亚拉巴，过约旦河，走过毕伦，到了玛哈念。
2.en: Abner and his men went all that night through the Arabah; and they passed over the Jordan, and went through all Bithron, and came to Mahanaim.

2.zh: 约押追赶押尼珥回来，聚集众民，见大卫的仆人中缺少了十九个人和亚撒黑。
2.en: Joab returned from following Abner; and when he had gathered all the people together, nineteen men of David’s and Asahel were missing.

2.zh: 但大卫的仆人杀了便雅悯人和跟随押尼珥的人，共三百六十名。
2.en: But David’s servants had struck Benjamin and Abner’s men so that three hundred sixty men died.

2.zh: 众人将亚撒黑送到伯利恒，葬在他父亲的坟墓里。约押和跟随他的人走了一夜，天亮的时候到了希伯 。
2.en: They took up Asahel and buried him in the tomb of his father, which was in Bethlehem. Joab and his men went all night, and the day broke on them at Hebron.

3.zh: 扫罗家和大卫家争战许久。大卫家日见强盛；扫罗家日见衰弱。
3.en: Now there was a long war between Saul’s house and David’s house. David grew stronger and stronger, but Saul’s house grew weaker and weaker.

3.zh: 大卫在希伯 得了几个儿子：长子暗嫩是耶斯列人亚希暖所生的；
3.en: Sons were born to David in Hebron. His firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess;

3.zh: 次子基利押是作过迦密人拿八的妻亚比该所生的；三子押沙龙是基述王达买的女儿玛迦所生的；
3.en: and his second, Chileab, of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;

3.zh: 四子亚多尼雅是哈及所生的；五子示法提雅是亚比她所生的；
3.en: and the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; and the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;

3.zh: 六子以特念是大卫的妻以格拉所生的。大卫这六个儿子都是在希伯 生的。
3.en: and the sixth, Ithream, of Eglah, David’s wife. These were born to David in Hebron.

3.zh: 扫罗家和大卫家争战的时候，押尼珥在扫罗家大有权势。
3.en: While there was war between Saul’s house and David’s house, Abner made himself strong in Saul’s house.

3.zh: 扫罗有一妃嫔，名叫利斯巴，是爱亚的女儿。一日，伊施波设对押尼珥说：「你为什么与我父的妃嫔同房呢？」
3.en: Now Saul had a concubine, whose name was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah; and Ishbosheth said to Abner, “Why have you gone in to my father’s concubine?”

3.zh: 押尼珥因伊施波设的话就甚发怒，说：「我岂是犹大的狗头呢？我恩待你父扫罗的家和他的弟兄、朋友，不将你交在大卫手里，今日你竟为这妇人责备我吗？
3.en: Then Abner was very angry about Ishbosheth’s words, and said, “Am I a dog’s head that belongs to Judah? Today I show kindness to your father Saul’s house, to his brothers, and to his friends, and have not delivered you into the hand of David; and yet you charge me today with a fault concerning this woman!

3.zh: 我若不照着耶和华起誓应许大卫的话行，废去扫罗的位，建立大卫的位，使他治理以色列和犹大，从但直到别是巴，愿　神重重地降罚与我！」
3.en: God do so to Abner, and more also, if, as the LORD has sworn to David, I don’t do even so to him:
to transfer the kingdom from Saul’s house, and to set up David’s throne over Israel and over Judah, from Dan even to Beersheba.”

3.zh: 伊施波设惧怕押尼珥，不敢回答一句。
3.en: He could not answer Abner another word, because he was afraid of him.

3.zh: 押尼珥打发人去见大卫，替他说：「这国归谁呢？」又说：「你与我立约，我必帮助你，使以色列人都归服你。」
3.en: Abner sent messengers to David on his behalf, saying, “Whose is the land?” and saying, “Make your alliance with me, and behold, my hand will be with you to bring all Israel around to you.”

3.zh: 大卫说：「好！我与你立约。但有一件，你来见我面的时候，若不将扫罗的女儿米甲带来，必不得见我的面。」
3.en: David said, “Good. I will make a treaty with you, but one thing I require of you. That is, you will not see my face unless you first bring Michal, Saul’s daughter, when you come to see my face.”

3.zh: 大卫就打发人去见扫罗的儿子伊施波设，说：「你要将我的妻米甲归还我；她是我从前用一百非利士人的阳皮所聘定的。」
3.en: David sent messengers to Ishbosheth, Saul’s son, saying, “Deliver me my wife Michal, whom I was given to marry for one hundred foreskins of the Philistines.”

3.zh: 伊施波设就打发人去，将米甲从拉亿的儿子、她丈夫帕铁那里接回来。
3.en: Ishbosheth sent and took her from her husband, Paltiel the son of Laish.

3.zh: 米甲的丈夫跟着她，一面走一面哭，直跟到巴户琳。押尼珥说：「你回去吧！」帕铁就回去了。
3.en: Her husband went with her, weeping as he went, and followed her to Bahurim. Then Abner said to him, “Go! Return!” and he returned.

3.zh: 押尼珥对以色列长老说：「从前你们愿意大卫作王治理你们，
3.en: Abner had communication with the elders of Israel, saying, “In times past, you sought for David to be king over you.

3.zh: 现在你们可以照心愿而行。因为耶和华曾论到大卫说：『我必借我仆人大卫的手，救我民以色列脱离非利士人和众仇敌的手。』」
3.en: Now then do it! For the LORD has spoken of David, saying, ‘By the hand of my servant David, I will save my people Israel out of the hand of the Philistines, and out of the hand of all their enemies.’”

3.zh: 押尼珥也用这话说给便雅悯人听，又到希伯 ，将以色列人和便雅悯全家一切所喜悦的事说给大卫听。
3.en: Abner also spoke in the ears of Benjamin; and Abner went also to speak in the ears of David in Hebron all that seemed good to Israel and to the whole house of Benjamin.

3.zh: 押尼珥带着二十个人来到希伯 见大卫，大卫就为押尼珥和他带来的人设摆筵席。
3.en: So Abner came to David to Hebron, and twenty men with him. David made Abner and the men who were with him a feast.

3.zh: 押尼珥对大卫说：「我要起身去招聚以色列众人来见我主我王，与你立约，你就可以照着心愿作王。」于是大卫送押尼珥去，押尼珥就平平安安地去了。
3.en: Abner said to David, “I will arise and go, and will gather all Israel to my lord the king, that they may make a covenant with you, and that you may reign over all that your soul desires.” David sent Abner away; and he went in peace.

3.zh: 约押和大卫的仆人攻击敌军，带回许多的掠物。那时押尼珥不在希伯 大卫那里，因大卫已经送他去，他也平平安安地去了。
3.en: Behold, David’s servants and Joab came from a raid and brought in a great plunder with them; but Abner was not with David in Hebron, for he had sent him away, and he had gone in peace.

3.zh: 约押和跟随他的全军到了，就有人告诉约押说：「尼珥的儿子押尼珥来见王，王送他去，他也平平安安地去了。」
3.en: When Joab and all the army who was with him had come, they told Joab, “Abner the son of Ner came to the king, and he has sent him away, and he has gone in peace.”

3.zh: 约押去见王说：「你这是做什么呢？押尼珥来见你，你为何送他去，他就踪影不见了呢？
3.en: Then Joab came to the king and said, “What have you done? Behold, Abner came to you. Why is it that you have sent him away, and he is already gone?

3.zh: 你当晓得，尼珥的儿子押尼珥来是要诓哄你，要知道你的出入和你一切所行的事。」
3.en: You know Abner the son of Ner. He came to deceive you, and to know your going out and your coming in, and to know all that you do.”

3.zh: 约押从大卫那里出来，就打发人去追赶押尼珥，在西拉井追上他，将他带回来，大卫却不知道。
3.en: When Joab had come out from David, he sent messengers after Abner, and they brought him back from the well of Sirah; but David didn’t know it.

3.zh: 押尼珥回到希伯 ，约押领他到城门的瓮洞，假作要与他说机密话，就在那里刺透他的肚腹，他便死了。这是报杀他兄弟亚撒黑的仇。
3.en: When Abner had returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside into the middle of the gate to speak with him quietly, and struck him there in the body, so that he died for the blood of Asahel his brother.

3.zh: 大卫听见了，就说：「流尼珥的儿子押尼珥的血，这罪在耶和华面前必永不归我和我的国。
3.en: Afterward, when David heard it, he said, “I and my kingdom are guiltless before the LORD forever of the blood of Abner the son of Ner.

3.zh: 愿流他血的罪归到约押头上和他父的全家；又愿约押家不断有患漏症的，长大麻风的，架拐而行的，被刀杀死的，缺乏饮食的。」
3.en: Let it fall on the head of Joab and on all his father’s house. Let there not fail from the house of Joab one who has a discharge, or who is a leper, or who leans on a staff, or who falls by the sword, or who lacks bread.”

3.zh: 约押和他兄弟亚比筛杀了押尼珥，是因押尼珥在基遍争战的时候杀了他们的兄弟亚撒黑。
3.en: So Joab and Abishai his brother killed Abner, because he had killed their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle.

3.zh: 大卫吩咐约押和跟随他的众人说：「你们当撕裂衣服，腰束麻布，在押尼珥[棺]前哀哭。」大卫王也跟在棺后。
3.en: David said to Joab and to all the people who were with him, “Tear your clothes, and clothe yourselves with sackcloth, and mourn in front of Abner.” King David followed the bier.

3.zh: 他们将押尼珥葬在希伯 。王在押尼珥的墓旁放声而哭，众民也都哭了。
3.en: They buried Abner in Hebron; and the king lifted up his voice and wept at Abner’s grave; and all the people wept.

3.zh: 王为押尼珥举哀，说： 押尼珥何竟像愚顽人死呢？
3.en: The king lamented for Abner, and said, “Should Abner die as a fool dies?

3.zh: 你手未曾捆绑，脚未曾锁住。 你死，如人死在罪孽之辈手下一样。 于是众民又为押尼珥哀哭。
3.en: Your hands weren’t bound, and your feet weren’t put into fetters. As a man falls before the children of iniquity, so you fell.” All the people wept again over him.

3.zh: 日头未落的时候，众民来劝大卫吃饭，但大卫起誓说：「我若在日头未落以前吃饭，或吃别物，愿　神重重地降罚与我！」
3.en: All the people came to urge David to eat bread while it was yet day; but David swore, saying, “God do so to me, and more also, if I taste bread or anything else, until the sun goes down.”

3.zh: 众民知道了就都喜悦。凡王所行的，众民无不喜悦。
3.en: All the people took notice of it, and it pleased them, as whatever the king did pleased all the people.

3.zh: 那日，以色列众民才知道杀尼珥的儿子押尼珥并非出于王意。
3.en: So all the people and all Israel understood that day that it was not of the king to kill Abner the son of Ner.

3.zh: 王对臣仆说：「你们岂不知今日以色列人中死了一个作元帅的大丈夫吗？
3.en: The king said to his servants, “Don’t you know that a prince and a great man has fallen today in Israel?

3.zh: 我虽然受膏为王，今日还是软弱；这洗鲁雅的两个儿子比我刚强。愿耶和华照着恶人所行的恶报应他。」
3.en: I am weak today, though anointed king. These men, the sons of Zeruiah are too hard for me. May the LORD reward the evildoer according to his wickedness.”

4.zh: 扫罗的儿子伊施波设听见押尼珥死在希伯 ，手就发软；以色列众人也都惊惶。
4.en: When Saul’s son heard that Abner was dead in Hebron, his hands became feeble, and all the Israelites were troubled.

4.zh: 扫罗的儿子伊施波设有两个军长，一名巴拿，一名利甲，是便雅悯支派、比录人临门的儿子。比录也属便雅悯。
4.en: Saul’s son had two men who were captains of raiding bands. The name of one was Baanah and the name of the other Rechab, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, of the children of Benjamin (for Beeroth also is considered a part of Benjamin;

4.zh: 比录人早先逃到基他音，在那里寄居，直到今日。
4.en: and the Beerothites fled to Gittaim, and have lived as foreigners there until today).

4.zh: 扫罗的儿子约拿单有一个儿子名叫米非波设，是瘸腿的。扫罗和约拿单[死亡]的消息从耶斯列传到的时候，他才五岁。他乳母抱着他逃跑；因为跑得太急，孩子掉在地上，腿就瘸了。
4.en: Now Jonathan, Saul’s son, had a son who was lame in his feet. He was five years old when the news came about Saul and Jonathan out of Jezreel; and his nurse picked him up and fled. As she hurried to flee, he fell and became lame. His name was Mephibosheth.

4.zh: 一日，比录人临门的两个儿子利甲和巴拿出去，约在午热的时候到了伊施波设的家；伊施波设正睡午觉。
4.en: The sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, Rechab and Baanah, went out and came at about the heat of the day to the house of Ishbosheth as he took his rest at noon.

4.zh: 他们进了房子，假作要取麦子，就刺透伊施波设的肚腹，逃跑了。
4.en: They came there into the middle of the house as though they would have fetched wheat, and they struck him in the body; and Rechab and Baanah his brother escaped.

4.zh: 他们进房子的时候，伊施波设正在卧房里躺在床上，他们将他杀死，割了他的首级，拿着首级在亚拉巴走了一夜，
4.en: Now when they came into the house as he lay on his bed in his bedroom, they struck him, killed him, beheaded him, and took his head, and went by the way of the Arabah all night.

4.zh: 将伊施波设的首级拿到希伯 见大卫王，说：「王的仇敌扫罗曾寻索王的性命。看哪，这是他儿子伊施波设的首级；耶和华今日为我主我王在扫罗和他后裔的身上报了仇。」
4.en: They brought the head of Ishbosheth to David to Hebron, and said to the king, “Behold, the head of Ishbosheth, the son of Saul, your enemy, who sought your life! The LORD has avenged my lord the king today of Saul and of his offspring.”

4.zh: 大卫对比录人临门的儿子利甲和他兄弟巴拿说：「我指着救我性命脱离一切苦难、永生的耶和华起誓：
4.en: David answered Rechab and Baanah his brother, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, and said to them, “As the LORD lives, who has redeemed my soul out of all adversity,

4.zh: 从前有人报告我说，扫罗死了，他自以为报好消息；我就拿住他，将他杀在洗革拉，这就作了他报消息的赏赐。
4.en: when someone told me, ‘Behold, Saul is dead,’ thinking that he brought good news, I seized him and killed him in Ziklag, which was the reward I gave him for his news.

4.zh: 何况恶人将义人杀在他的床上，我岂不向你们讨流他血的罪、从世上除灭你们呢？」
4.en: How much more, when wicked men have slain a righteous person in his own house on his bed, should I not now require his blood from your hand, and rid the earth of you?”

4.zh: 于是大卫吩咐少年人将他们杀了，砍断他们的手脚，挂在希伯 的池旁，却将伊施波设的首级葬在希伯 、押尼珥的坟墓里。
4.en: David commanded his young men, and they killed them, cut off their hands and their feet, and hanged them up beside the pool in Hebron. But they took the head of Ishbosheth and buried it in Abner’s grave in Hebron.

5.zh: 以色列众支派来到希伯 见大卫，说：「我们原是你的骨肉。
5.en: Then all the tribes of Israel came to David at Hebron and spoke, saying, “Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.

5.zh: 从前扫罗作我们王的时候，率领以色列人出入的是你；耶和华也曾应许你说：『你必牧养我的民以色列，作以色列的君。』」
5.en: In times past, when Saul was king over us, it was you who led Israel out and in. The LORD said to you, ‘You will be shepherd of my people Israel, and you will be prince over Israel.’”

5.zh: 于是以色列的长老都来到希伯 见大卫王，大卫在希伯 耶和华面前与他们立约，他们就膏大卫作以色列的王。
5.en: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron, and King David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD; and they anointed David king over Israel.

5.zh: 大卫登基的时候年三十岁，在位四十年；
5.en: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.

5.zh: 在希伯 作犹大王七年零六个月，在耶路撒冷作以色列和犹大王三十三年。
5.en: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months, and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty-three years over all Israel and Judah.

5.zh: 大卫和跟随他的人到了耶路撒冷，要攻打住那地方的耶布斯人。耶布斯人对大卫说：「你若不赶出瞎子、瘸子，必不能进这地方」；心里想大卫决不能进去。
5.en: The king and his men went to Jerusalem against the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, who spoke to David, saying, “The blind and the lame will keep you out of here,” thinking, “David can’t come in here.”

5.zh: 然而大卫攻取锡安的保障，就是大卫的城。
5.en: Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion. This is David’s city.

5.zh: 当日，大卫说：「谁攻打耶布斯人，当上水沟[攻打]我心里所恨恶的瘸子、瞎子。」从此有俗语说：「在那里有瞎子、瘸子，他不能进屋去。」
5.en: David said on that day, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites, let him go up to the watercourse and strike those lame and blind, who are hated by David’s soul.” Therefore they say, “The blind and the lame can’t come into the house.”

5.zh: 大卫住在保障里，给保障起名叫大卫城。大卫又从米罗以里，周围筑墙。
5.en: David lived in the stronghold, and called it David’s city. David built around from Millo and inward.

5.zh: 大卫日见强盛，因为耶和华—万军之　神与他同在。
5.en: David grew greater and greater, for the LORD, the God of Armies, was with him.

5.zh: 泰尔王希兰将香柏木运到大卫那里，又差遣使者和木匠、石匠给大卫建造宫殿。
5.en: Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, with cedar trees, carpenters, and masons; and they built David a house.

5.zh: 大卫就知道耶和华坚立他作以色列王，又为自己的民以色列使他的国兴旺。
5.en: David perceived that the LORD had established him king over Israel, and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel’s sake.

5.zh: 大卫离开希伯 之后，在耶路撒冷又立后妃，又生儿女。
5.en: David took more concubines and wives for himself out of Jerusalem, after he had come from Hebron; and more sons and daughters were born to David.

5.zh: 在耶路撒冷所生的儿子是沙母亚、朔罢、拿单、所罗门、
5.en: These are the names of those who were born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,

5.zh: 益辖、以利书亚、尼斐、雅非亚、
5.en: Ibhar, Elishua, Nepheg, Japhia,

5.zh: 以利沙玛、以利雅大、以利法列。
5.en: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet.

5.zh: 非利士人听见人膏大卫作以色列王，非利士众人就上来寻索大卫；大卫听见，就下到保障。
5.en: When the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David, but David heard about it and went down to the stronghold.

5.zh: 非利士人来了，布散在利乏音谷。
5.en: Now the Philistines had come and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

5.zh: 大卫求问耶和华说：「我可以上去攻打非利士人吗？你将他们交在我手里吗？」耶和华说：「你可以上去，我必将非利士人交在你手里。」
5.en: David inquired of the LORD, saying, “Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hand?” The LORD said to David, “Go up; for I will certainly deliver the Philistines into your hand.”

5.zh: 大卫来到巴力·毗拉心，在那里击杀非利士人，说：「耶和华在我面前冲破敌人，如同水冲去一般。」因此称那地方为巴力·毗拉心。
5.en: David came to Baal Perazim, and David struck them there. Then he said, “The LORD has broken my enemies before me, like the breach of waters.” Therefore he called the name of that place Baal Perazim.

5.zh: 非利士人将偶像撇在那里，大卫和跟随他的人拿去了。
5.en: They left their images there, and David and his men took them away.

5.zh: 非利士人又上来，布散在利乏音谷。
5.en: The Philistines came up yet again and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

5.zh: 大卫求问耶和华；耶和华说：「不要一直地上去，要转到他们后头，从桑林对面攻打他们。
5.en: When David inquired of the LORD, he said, “You shall not go up. Circle around behind them, and attack them in front of the mulberry trees.

5.zh: 你听见桑树梢上有脚步的声音，就要急速前去，因为那时耶和华已经在你前头去攻打非利士人的军队。」
5.en: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then stir yourself up; for then the LORD has gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines.”

5.zh: 大卫就遵着耶和华所吩咐的去行，攻打非利士人，从迦巴直到基色。
5.en: David did so, as the LORD commanded him, and struck the Philistines all the way from Geba to Gezer.

6.zh: 大卫又聚集以色列中所有挑选的人三万。
6.en: David again gathered together all the chosen men of Israel, thirty thousand.

6.zh: 大卫起身，率领跟随他的众人前往，要从巴拉·犹大将　神的[约]柜运来；这[约]柜就是坐在二基路伯上万军之耶和华留名的[约]柜。
6.en: David arose and went with all the people who were with him from Baale Judah, to bring up from there God’s ark, which is called by the Name, even the name of the LORD of Armies who sits above the cherubim.

6.zh: 他们将　神的[约]柜从冈上亚比拿达的家里抬出来，放在新车上；亚比拿达的两个儿子乌撒和亚希约赶这新车。
6.en: They set God’s ark on a new cart, and brought it out of Abinadab’s house that was on the hill; and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, drove the new cart.

6.zh: 他们将　神的[约]柜从冈上亚比拿达家里抬出来的时候，亚希约在柜前行走。
6.en: They brought it out of Abinadab’s house which was in the hill, with God’s ark; and Ahio went before the ark.

6.zh: 大卫和以色列的全家在耶和华面前，用松木制造的各样[乐器]和琴、瑟、鼓、钹、锣，作乐跳舞。
6.en: David and all the house of Israel played before the LORD with all kinds of instruments made of cypress wood, with harps, with stringed instruments, with tambourines, with castanets, and with cymbals.

6.zh: 到了拿艮的禾场，因为牛失前蹄，乌撒就伸[手]扶住　神的[约]柜。
6.en: When they came to the threshing floor of Nacon, Uzzah reached for God’s ark and took hold of it, for the cattle stumbled.

6.zh: 神耶和华向乌撒发怒，因这错误击杀他，他就死在　神的[约]柜旁。
6.en: The LORD’s anger burned against Uzzah, and God struck him there for his error; and he died there by God’s ark.

6.zh: 大卫因耶和华击杀乌撒，心里愁烦，就称那地方为毗列斯·乌撒，直到今日。
6.en: David was displeased because the LORD had broken out against Uzzah; and he called that place Perez Uzzah to this day.

6.zh: 那日，大卫惧怕耶和华，说：「耶和华的[约]柜怎可运到我这里来？」
6.en: David was afraid of the LORD that day; and he said, “How could the LORD’s ark come to me?”

6.zh: 于是大卫不肯将耶和华的[约]柜运进大卫的城，却运到迦特人俄别·以东的家中。
6.en: So David would not move the LORD’s ark to be with him in David’s city; but David carried it aside into Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house.

6.zh: 耶和华的[约]柜在迦特人俄别·以东家中三个月；耶和华赐福给俄别·以东和他的全家。
6.en: The LORD’s ark remained in Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house three months; and the LORD blessed Obed-Edom and all his house.

6.zh: 有人告诉大卫王说：「耶和华因为[约]柜赐福给俄别·以东的家和一切属他的。」大卫就去，欢欢喜喜地将　神的[约]柜从俄别·以东家中抬到大卫的城里。
6.en: King David was told, “The LORD has blessed the house of Obed-Edom, and all that belongs to him, because of God’s ark.” So David went and brought up God’s ark from the house of Obed-Edom into David’s city with joy.

6.zh: 抬耶和华[约]柜的人走了六步，大卫就献牛与肥羊为祭。
6.en: When those who bore the LORD’s ark had gone six paces, he sacrificed an ox and a fattened calf.

6.zh: 大卫穿着细麻布的以弗得，在耶和华面前极力跳舞。
6.en: David danced before the LORD with all his might; and David was clothed in a linen ephod.

6.zh: 这样，大卫和以色列的全家欢呼吹角，将耶和华的[约]柜抬上来。
6.en: So David and all the house of Israel brought up the LORD’s ark with shouting and with the sound of the trumpet.

6.zh: 耶和华的[约]柜进了大卫城的时候，扫罗的女儿米甲从窗户里观看，见大卫王在耶和华面前踊跃跳舞，心里就轻视他。
6.en: As the LORD’s ark came into David’s city, Michal the daughter of Saul looked out through the window and saw King David leaping and dancing before the LORD; and she despised him in her heart.

6.zh: 众人将耶和华的[约]柜请进去，安放在所预备的地方，就是在大卫所搭的帐幕里。大卫在耶和华面前献燔祭和平安祭。
6.en: They brought in the LORD’s ark, and set it in its place in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it; and David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD.

6.zh: 大卫献完了燔祭和平安祭，就奉万军之耶和华的名给民祝福，
6.en: When David had finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD of Armies.

6.zh: 并且分给以色列众人，无论男女，每人一个饼，一块[肉]，一个葡萄饼；众人就各回各家去了。
6.en: He gave to all the people, even among the whole multitude of Israel, both to men and women, to everyone a portion of bread, dates, and raisins. So all the people departed, each to his own house.

6.zh: 大卫回家要给眷属祝福；扫罗的女儿米甲出来迎接他，说：「以色列王今日在臣仆的婢女眼前露体，如同一个轻贱人无耻露体一样，有好大的荣耀啊！」
6.en: Then David returned to bless his household. Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David, and said, “How glorious the king of Israel was today, who uncovered himself today in the eyes of his servants’ maids, as one of the vain fellows shamelessly uncovers himself!”

6.zh: 大卫对米甲说：「这是在耶和华面前；耶和华已拣选我，废了你父和你父的全家，立我作耶和华民以色列的君，所以我必在耶和华面前跳舞。
6.en: David said to Michal, “It was before the LORD, who chose me above your father, and above all his house, to appoint me prince over the people of the LORD, over Israel. Therefore I will celebrate before the LORD.

6.zh: 我也必更加卑微，自己看为轻贱。你所说的那些婢女，她们倒要尊敬我。」
6.en: I will be yet more undignified than this, and will be worthless in my own sight. But the maids of whom you have spoken will honor me.”

6.zh: 扫罗的女儿米甲，直到死日，没有生养儿女。
6.en: Michal the daughter of Saul had no child to the day of her death.

7.zh: 王住在自己宫中，耶和华使他安靖，不被四围的仇敌扰乱。
7.en: When the king lived in his house, and the LORD had given him rest from all his enemies all around,

7.zh: 那时，王对先知拿单说：「看哪，我住在香柏木的宫中，　神的[约]柜反在幔子里。」
7.en: the king said to Nathan the prophet, “See now, I dwell in a house of cedar, but God’s ark dwells within curtains.”

7.zh: 拿单对王说：「你可以照你的心意而行，因为耶和华与你同在。」
7.en: Nathan said to the king, “Go, do all that is in your heart, for the LORD is with you.”

7.zh: 当夜，耶和华的话临到拿单说：
7.en: That same night, the LORD’s word came to Nathan, saying,

7.zh: 「你去告诉我仆人大卫，说耶和华如此说：『你岂可建造殿宇给我居住呢？
7.en: “Go and tell my servant David, ‘The LORD says, “Should you build me a house for me to dwell in?

7.zh: 自从我领以色列人出埃及直到今日，我未曾住过殿宇，常在会幕和帐幕中行走。
7.en: For I have not lived in a house since the day that I brought the children of Israel up out of Egypt, even to this day, but have moved around in a tent and in a tabernacle.

7.zh: 凡我同以色列人所走的地方，我何曾向以色列一支派[的士师]，就是我吩咐牧养我民以色列的说：你们为何不给我建造香柏木的殿宇呢？』
7.en: In all places in which I have walked with all the children of Israel, did I say a word to anyone from the tribes of Israel whom I commanded to be shepherd of my people Israel, saying, ‘Why have you not built me a house of cedar?’”’

7.zh: 「现在，你要告诉我仆人大卫，说万军之耶和华如此说：『我从羊圈中将你召来，叫你不再跟从羊群，立你作我民以色列的君。
7.en: Now therefore tell my servant David this: ‘The LORD of Armies says, “I took you from the sheep pen, from following the sheep, to be prince over my people, over Israel.

7.zh: 你无论往哪里去，我常与你同在，剪除你的一切仇敌。我必使你得大名，好像世上大大有名的人一样。
7.en: I have been with you wherever you went, and have cut off all your enemies from before you. I will make you a great name, like the name of the great ones who are on the earth.

7.zh: 我必为我民以色列选定一个地方，栽培他们，使他们住自己的地方，不再迁移；凶恶之子也不像从前扰害他们，
7.en: I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in their own place and be moved no more. The children of wickedness will not afflict them any more, as at the first,

7.zh: 并不像我命士师治理我民以色列的时候一样。我必使你安靖，不被一切仇敌扰乱，并且我—耶和华应许你，必为你建立家室。
7.en: and as from the day that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. I will cause you to rest from all your enemies. Moreover the LORD tells you that the LORD will make you a house.

7.zh: 你寿数满足、与你列祖同睡的时候，我必使你的后裔接续你的位；我也必坚定他的国。
7.en: When your days are fulfilled and you sleep with your fathers, I will set up your offspring after you, who will proceed out of your body, and I will establish his kingdom.

7.zh: 他必为我的名建造殿宇；我必坚定他的国位，直到永远。
7.en: He will build a house for my name, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever.

7.zh: 我要作他的父，他要作我的子；他若犯了罪，我必用人的杖责打他，用人的鞭责罚他。
7.en: I will be his father, and he will be my son. If he commits iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men and with the stripes of the children of men;

7.zh: 但我的慈爱仍不离开他，像离开在你面前所废弃的扫罗一样。
7.en: but my loving kindness will not depart from him, as I took it from Saul, whom I put away before you.

7.zh: 你的家和你的国必在我面前永远坚立。你的国位也必坚定，直到永远。』」
7.en: Your house and your kingdom will be made sure forever before you. Your throne will be established forever.”’”

7.zh: 拿单就按这一切话，照这默示，告诉大卫。
7.en: Nathan spoke to David all these words, and according to all this vision.

7.zh: 于是大卫王进去，坐在耶和华面前，说：「主耶和华啊，我是谁？我的家算什么？你竟使我到这地步呢？
7.en: Then David the king went in and sat before the LORD; and he said, “Who am I, Lord GOD, and what is my house, that you have brought me this far?

7.zh: 主耶和华啊，这在你眼中还看为小，又应许你仆人的家至于久远。主耶和华啊，这岂是人所常遇的事吗？
7.en: This was yet a small thing in your eyes, Lord GOD, but you have spoken also of your servant’s house for a great while to come; and this among men, Lord GOD!

7.zh: 主耶和华啊，我还有何言可以对你说呢？因为你知道你的仆人。
7.en: What more can David say to you? For you know your servant, Lord GOD.

7.zh: 你行这大事使仆人知道，是因你所应许的话，也是照你的心意。
7.en: For your word’s sake, and according to your own heart, you have worked all this greatness, to make your servant know it.

7.zh: 主耶和华啊，你本为大，照我们耳中听见，没有可比你的；除你以外再无　神。
7.en: Therefore you are great, LORD God. For there is no one like you, neither is there any God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

7.zh: 世上有何民能比你的民以色列呢？你从埃及救赎他们作自己的子民，又在你赎出来的民面前行大而可畏的事，[驱逐]列邦人和他们的神，显出你的大名。
7.en: What one nation on the earth is like your people, even like Israel, whom God went to redeem to himself for a people, and to make himself a name, and to do great things for you, and awesome things for your land, before your people, whom you redeemed to yourself out of Egypt, from the nations and their gods?

7.zh: 你曾坚立你的民以色列作你的子民，直到永远；你—耶和华也作了他们的　神。
7.en: You established for yourself your people Israel to be your people forever; and you, LORD, became their God.

7.zh: 「耶和华　神啊，你所应许仆人和仆人家的话，求你坚定，直到永远；照你所说的而行。
7.en: “Now, LORD God, the word that you have spoken concerning your servant, and concerning his house, confirm it forever, and do as you have spoken.

7.zh: 愿人永远尊你的名为大，说：『万军之耶和华是治理以色列的　神。』这样，你仆人大卫的家必在你面前坚立。
7.en: Let your name be magnified forever, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies is God over Israel; and the house of your servant David will be established before you.’

7.zh: 万军之耶和华—以色列的　神啊，因你启示你的仆人说：『我必为你建立家室』，所以仆人大胆向你如此祈祷。
7.en: For you, LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, have revealed to your servant, saying, ‘I will build you a house.’ Therefore your servant has found in his heart to pray this prayer to you.

7.zh: 「主耶和华啊，惟有你是　神。你的话是真实的；你也应许将这福气赐给仆人。
7.en: “Now, O Lord GOD, you are God, and your words are truth, and you have promised this good thing to your servant.

7.zh: 现在求你赐福与仆人的家，可以永存在你面前。主耶和华啊，这是你所应许的。愿你永远赐福与仆人的家！」
7.en: Now therefore, let it please you to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever before you; for you, Lord GOD, have spoken it. Let the house of your servant be blessed forever with your blessing.”

8.zh: 此后，大卫攻打非利士人，把他们治服，从他们手下夺取了京城的权柄；
8.en: After this, David struck the Philistines and subdued them; and David took the bridle of the mother city out of the hand of the Philistines.

8.zh: 又攻打摩押人，使他们躺卧在地上，用绳量一量：量二绳的杀了，量一绳的存留。摩押人就归服大卫，给他进贡。
8.en: He defeated Moab, and measured them with the line, making them to lie down on the ground; and he measured two lines to put to death, and one full line to keep alive. The Moabites became servants to David, and brought tribute.

8.zh: 琐巴王利合的儿子哈大底谢往大河去，要夺回他的国权。大卫就攻打他，
8.en: David also struck Hadadezer the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his dominion at the River.

8.zh: 擒拿了他的马兵一千七百，步兵二万，将拉战车的马砍断蹄筋，但留下一百辆车的马。
8.en: David took from him one thousand seven hundred horsemen and twenty thousand footmen. David hamstrung the chariot horses, but reserved enough of them for one hundred chariots.

8.zh: 大马士革的亚兰人来帮助琐巴王哈大底谢，大卫就杀了亚兰人二万二千。
8.en: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck twenty two thousand men of the Syrians.

8.zh: 于是大卫在大马士革的亚兰地设立防营，亚兰人就归服他，给他进贡。大卫无论往哪里去，耶和华都使他得胜。
8.en: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David, and brought tribute. The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.

8.zh: 他夺了哈大底谢臣仆所拿的金盾牌，带到耶路撒冷。
8.en: David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

8.zh: 大卫王又从属哈大底谢的比他和比罗他城中夺取了许多的铜。
8.en: From Betah and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, King David took a great quantity of bronze.

8.zh: 哈马王陀以听见大卫杀败哈大底谢的全军，
8.en: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had struck all the army of Hadadezer,

8.zh: 就打发他儿子约兰去见大卫王，问他的安，为他祝福，因为他杀败了哈大底谢（原来陀以与哈大底谢常常争战）。约兰带了金银铜的器皿来，
8.en: then Toi sent Joram his son to King David to greet him and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him; for Hadadezer had wars with Toi. Joram brought with him vessels of silver, vessels of gold, and vessels of bronze.

8.zh: 大卫王将这些器皿和他治服各国所得来的金银都分别为圣，献给耶和华，
8.en: King David also dedicated these to the LORD, with the silver and gold that he dedicated of all the nations which he subdued—

8.zh: 就是从亚兰、摩押、亚扪、非利士、亚玛力人所得来的，以及从琐巴王利合的儿子哈大底谢所掠之物。
8.en: of Syria, of Moab, of the children of Ammon, of the Philistines, of Amalek, and of the plunder of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.

8.zh: 大卫在盐谷击杀了亚兰一万八千人回来，就得了大名；
8.en: David earned a reputation when he returned from striking down eighteen thousand men of the Syrians in the Valley of Salt.

8.zh: 又在以东全地设立防营，以东人就都归服大卫。大卫无论往哪里去，耶和华都使他得胜。
8.en: He put garrisons in Edom. Throughout all Edom, he put garrisons, and all the Edomites became servants to David. The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.

8.zh: 大卫作以色列众人的王，又向众民秉公行义。
8.en: David reigned over all Israel; and David executed justice and righteousness for all his people.

8.zh: 洗鲁雅的儿子约押作元帅；亚希律的儿子约沙法作史官；
8.en: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army, Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder,

8.zh: 亚希突的儿子撒督和亚比亚他的儿子亚希米勒作祭司[长]；西莱雅作书记；
8.en: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar were priests, Seraiah was scribe,

8.zh: 耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅统辖基利提人和比利提人。大卫的众子都作领袖。
8.en: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David’s sons were chief ministers.

9.zh: 大卫问说：「扫罗家还有剩下的人没有？我要因约拿单的缘故向他施恩。」
9.en: David said, “Is there yet any who is left of Saul’s house, that I may show him kindness for Jonathan’s sake?”

9.zh: 扫罗家有一个仆人，名叫洗巴，有人叫他来见大卫，王问他说：「你是洗巴吗？」回答说：「仆人是。」
9.en: There was of Saul’s house a servant whose name was Ziba, and they called him to David; and the king said to him, “Are you Ziba?” He said, “I am your servant.”

9.zh: 王说：「扫罗家还有人没有？我要照　神的慈爱恩待他。」洗巴对王说：「还有约拿单的一个儿子，是瘸腿的。」
9.en: The king said, “Is there not yet any of Saul’s house, that I may show the kindness of God to him?” Ziba said to the king, “Jonathan still has a son, who is lame in his feet.”

9.zh: 王说：「他在哪里？」洗巴对王说：「他在罗·底巴，亚米利的儿子玛吉家里。」
9.en: The king said to him, “Where is he?” Ziba said to the king, “Behold, he is in the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, in Lo Debar.”

9.zh: 于是大卫王打发人去，从罗·底巴、亚米利的儿子玛吉家里召了他来。
9.en: Then King David sent and brought him out of the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, from Lo Debar.

9.zh: 扫罗的孙子、约拿单的儿子米非波设来见大卫，伏地叩拜。大卫说：「米非波设！」米非波设说：「仆人在此。」
9.en: Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, came to David, fell on his face, and showed respect. David said, “Mephibosheth?” He answered, “Behold, your servant!”

9.zh: 大卫说：「你不要惧怕，我必因你父亲约拿单的缘故施恩与你，将你祖父扫罗的一切田地都归还你；你也可以常与我同席吃饭。」
9.en: David said to him, “Don’t be afraid, for I will surely show you kindness for Jonathan your father’s sake, and will restore to you all the land of Saul your father. You will eat bread at my table continually.”

9.zh: 米非波设又叩拜，说：「仆人算什么，不过如死狗一般，竟蒙王这样眷顾！」
9.en: He bowed down, and said, “What is your servant, that you should look at such a dead dog as I am?”

9.zh: 王召了扫罗的仆人洗巴来，对他说：「我已将属扫罗和他的一切家产都赐给你主人的儿子了。
9.en: Then the king called to Ziba, Saul’s servant, and said to him, “All that belonged to Saul and to all his house I have given to your master’s son.

9.zh: 你和你的众子、仆人要为你主人的儿子米非波设耕种田地，把所产的拿来供他食用；他却要常与我同席吃饭。」洗巴有十五个儿子，二十个仆人。
9.en: Till the land for him—you, your sons, and your servants. Bring in the harvest, that your master’s son may have bread to eat; but Mephibosheth your master’s son will always eat bread at my table.” Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.

9.zh: 洗巴对王说：「凡我主我王吩咐仆人的，仆人都必遵行。」王又说：「米非波设必与我同席吃饭，如王的儿子一样。」
9.en: Then Ziba said to the king, “According to all that my lord the king commands his servant, so your servant will do.” So Mephibosheth ate at the king’s table like one of the king’s sons.

9.zh: 米非波设有一个小儿子，名叫米迦。凡住在洗巴家里的人都作了米非波设的仆人。
9.en: Mephibosheth had a young son, whose name was Mica. All who lived in Ziba’s house were servants to Mephibosheth.

9.zh: 于是米非波设住在耶路撒冷，常与王同席吃饭。他两腿都是瘸的。
9.en: So Mephibosheth lived in Jerusalem, for he ate continually at the king’s table. He was lame in both his feet.

10.zh: 此后，亚扪人的王死了，他儿子哈嫩接续他作王。
10.en: After this, the king of the children of Ammon died, and Hanun his son reigned in his place.

10.zh: 大卫说：「我要照哈嫩的父亲拿辖厚待我的恩典厚待哈嫩。」于是大卫差遣臣仆，为他丧父安慰他。大卫的臣仆到了亚扪人的境内。
10.en: David said, “I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, as his father showed kindness to me.” So David sent by his servants to comfort him concerning his father. David’s servants came into the land of the children of Ammon.

10.zh: 但亚扪人的首领对他们的主哈嫩说：「大卫差人来安慰你，你想他是尊敬你父亲吗？他差臣仆来不是详察窥探、要倾覆这城吗？」
10.en: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun their lord, “Do you think that David honors your father, in that he has sent comforters to you? Hasn’t David sent his servants to you to search the city, to spy it out, and to overthrow it?”

10.zh: 哈嫩便将大卫臣仆的胡须剃去一半，又割断他们下半截的衣服，使他们露出下体，打发他们回去。
10.en: So Hanun took David’s servants, shaved off one half of their beards, and cut off their garments in the middle, even to their buttocks, and sent them away.

10.zh: 有人告诉大卫，他就差人去迎接他们，（因为他们甚觉羞耻），告诉他们说：「可以住在耶利哥，等到胡须长起再回来。」
10.en: When they told David this, he sent to meet them, for the men were greatly ashamed. The king said, “Wait at Jericho until your beards have grown, and then return.”

10.zh: 亚扪人知道大卫憎恶他们，就打发人去，招募伯·利合的亚兰人和琐巴的亚兰人，步兵二万，与玛迦王的人一千、陀伯人一万二千。
10.en: When the children of Ammon saw that they had become odious to David, the children of Ammon sent and hired the Syrians of Beth Rehob and the Syrians of Zobah, twenty thousand footmen, and the king of Maacah with one thousand men, and the men of Tob twelve thousand men.

10.zh: 大卫听见了，就差派约押统带勇猛的全军出去。
10.en: When David heard of it, he sent Joab and all the army of the mighty men.

10.zh: 亚扪人出来，在城门前摆阵；琐巴与利合的亚兰人、陀伯人，并玛迦人，另在郊野摆阵。
10.en: The children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the entrance of the gate. The Syrians of Zobah and of Rehob and the men of Tob and Maacah were by themselves in the field.

10.zh: 约押看见敌人在他前后摆阵，就从以色列军中挑选精兵，使他们对着亚兰人摆阵。
10.en: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose of all the choice men of Israel and put them in array against the Syrians.

10.zh: 其余的兵交与他兄弟亚比筛，对着亚扪人摆阵。
10.en: The rest of the people he committed into the hand of Abishai his brother; and he put them in array against the children of Ammon.

10.zh: 约押对亚比筛说：「亚兰人若强过我，你就来帮助我；亚扪人若强过你，我就去帮助你。
10.en: He said, “If the Syrians are too strong for me, then you shall help me; but if the children of Ammon are too strong for you, then I will come and help you.

10.zh: 我们都当刚强，为本国的民和　神的城邑作大丈夫。愿耶和华凭他的意旨而行！」
10.en: Be courageous, and let’s be strong for our people and for the cities of our God; and may the LORD do what seems good to him.”

10.zh: 于是，约押和跟随他的人前进攻打亚兰人；亚兰人在约押面前逃跑。
10.en: So Joab and the people who were with him came near to the battle against the Syrians, and they fled before him.

10.zh: 亚扪人见亚兰人逃跑，他们也在亚比筛面前逃跑进城。约押就离开亚扪人那里，回耶路撒冷去了。
10.en: When the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled, they likewise fled before Abishai, and entered into the city. Then Joab returned from the children of Ammon and came to Jerusalem.

10.zh: 亚兰人见自己被以色列人打败，就又聚集。
10.en: When the Syrians saw that they were defeated by Israel, they gathered themselves together.

10.zh: 哈大底谢差遣人，将大河那边的亚兰人调来；他们到了希兰，哈大底谢的将军朔法率领他们。
10.en: Hadadezer sent and brought out the Syrians who were beyond the River; and they came to Helam, with Shobach the captain of the army of Hadadezer at their head.

10.zh: 有人告诉大卫，他就聚集以色列众人，过约旦河，来到希兰。亚兰人迎着大卫摆阵，与他打仗。
10.en: David was told that; and he gathered all Israel together, passed over the Jordan, and came to Helam. The Syrians set themselves in array against David and fought with him.

10.zh: 亚兰人在以色列人面前逃跑；大卫杀了亚兰七百辆战车[的人]，四万马兵，又杀了亚兰的将军朔法。
10.en: The Syrians fled before Israel; and David killed seven hundred charioteers of the Syrians and forty thousand horsemen, and struck Shobach the captain of their army, so that he died there.

10.zh: 属哈大底谢的诸王见自己被以色列人打败，就与以色列人和好，归服他们。于是亚兰人不敢再帮助亚扪人了。
10.en: When all the kings who were servants to Hadadezer saw that they were defeated before Israel, they made peace with Israel and served them. So the Syrians were afraid to help the children of Ammon any more.

11.zh: 过了一年，到列王出战的时候，大卫又差派约押，率领臣仆和以色列众人出[战]。他们就打败亚扪人，围攻拉巴。大卫仍住在耶路撒冷。
11.en: At the return of the year, at the time when kings go out, David sent Joab and his servants with him, and all Israel; and they destroyed the children of Ammon and besieged Rabbah. But David stayed at Jerusalem.

11.zh: 一日，太阳平西，大卫从床上起来，在王宫的平顶上游行，看见一个妇人沐浴，容貌甚美，
11.en: At evening, David arose from his bed and walked on the roof of the king’s house. From the roof, he saw a woman bathing, and the woman was very beautiful to look at.

11.zh: 大卫就差人打听那妇人是谁。有人说：「她是以连的女儿，赫人乌利亚的妻拔示巴。」
11.en: David sent and inquired after the woman. One said, “Isn’t this Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam, Uriah the Hittite’s wife?”

11.zh: 大卫差人去，将妇人接来；那时她的月经才得洁净。她来了，大卫与她同房，她就回家去了。
11.en: David sent messengers, and took her; and she came in to him, and he lay with her (for she was purified from her uncleanness); and she returned to her house.

11.zh: 于是她怀了孕，打发人去告诉大卫说：「我怀了孕。」
11.en: The woman conceived; and she sent and told David, and said, “I am with child.”

11.zh: 大卫差人到约押那里，[说]：「你打发赫人乌利亚到我这里来。」约押就打发乌利亚去见大卫。
11.en: David sent to Joab, “Send me Uriah the Hittite.” Joab sent Uriah to David.

11.zh: 乌利亚来了，大卫问约押好，也问兵好，又问争战的事怎样。
11.en: When Uriah had come to him, David asked him how Joab did, and how the people fared, and how the war prospered.

11.zh: 大卫对乌利亚说：「你回家去，洗洗脚吧！」乌利亚出了王宫，随后王送他一分[食]物。
11.en: David said to Uriah, “Go down to your house and wash your feet.” Uriah departed out of the king’s house, and a gift from the king was sent after him.

11.zh: 乌利亚却和他主人的仆人一同睡在宫门外，没有回家去。
11.en: But Uriah slept at the door of the king’s house with all the servants of his lord, and didn’t go down to his house.

11.zh: 有人告诉大卫说：「乌利亚没有回家去。」大卫就问乌利亚说：「你从远路上来，为什么不回家去呢？」
11.en: When they had told David, saying, “Uriah didn’t go down to his house,” David said to Uriah, “Haven’t you come from a journey? Why didn’t you go down to your house?”

11.zh: 乌利亚对大卫说：「[约]柜和以色列与犹大兵都住在棚里，我主约押和我主的仆人都在田野安营，我岂可回家吃喝、与妻子同寝呢？我敢在王面前起誓：我决不行这事！」
11.en: Uriah said to David, “The ark, Israel, and Judah, are staying in tents; and my lord Joab and the servants of my lord are encamped in the open field. Shall I then go into my house to eat and to drink, and to lie with my wife? As you live, and as your soul lives, I will not do this thing!”

11.zh: 大卫吩咐乌利亚说：「你今日仍住在这里，明日我打发你去。」于是乌利亚那日和次日住在耶路撒冷。
11.en: David said to Uriah, “Stay here today also, and tomorrow I will let you depart.” So Uriah stayed in Jerusalem that day and the next day.

11.zh: 大卫召了乌利亚来，叫他在自己面前吃喝，使他喝醉。到了晚上，乌利亚出去与他主的仆人一同住宿，还没有回到家里去。
11.en: When David had called him, he ate and drank before him; and he made him drunk. At evening, he went out to lie on his bed with the servants of his lord, but didn’t go down to his house.

11.zh: 次日早晨，大卫写信与约押，交乌利亚随手带去。
11.en: In the morning, David wrote a letter to Joab and sent it by the hand of Uriah.

11.zh: 信内写着说：「要派乌利亚前进，到阵势极险之处，你们便退后，使他被杀。」
11.en: He wrote in the letter, saying, “Send Uriah to the forefront of the hottest battle, and retreat from him, that he may be struck and die.”

11.zh: 约押围城的时候，知道敌人那里有勇士，便将乌利亚派在那里。
11.en: When Joab kept watch on the city, he assigned Uriah to the place where he knew that valiant men were.

11.zh: 城里的人出来和约押打仗；大卫的仆人中有几个被杀的，赫人乌利亚也死了。
11.en: The men of the city went out and fought with Joab. Some of the people fell, even of David’s servants; and Uriah the Hittite died also.

11.zh: 于是，约押差人去将争战的一切事告诉大卫，
11.en: Then Joab sent and told David all the things concerning the war;

11.zh: 又嘱咐使者说：「你把争战的一切事对王说完了，
11.en: and he commanded the messenger, saying, “When you have finished telling all the things concerning the war to the king,

11.zh: 王若发怒，问你说：『你们打仗为什么挨近城墙呢？岂不知敌人必从城上射箭吗？
11.en: it shall be that, if the king’s wrath arise, and he asks you, ‘Why did you go so near to the city to fight? Didn’t you know that they would shoot from the wall?

11.zh: 从前打死耶路·比设儿子亚比米勒的是谁呢？岂不是一个妇人从城上抛下一块上磨石来，打在他身上，他就死在提备斯吗？你们为什么挨近城墙呢？』你就说：『王的仆人—赫人乌利亚也死了。』」
11.en: Who struck Abimelech the son of Jerubbesheth? Didn’t a woman cast an upper millstone on him from the wall, so that he died at Thebez? Why did you go so near the wall?’ then you shall say, ‘Your servant Uriah the Hittite is also dead.’”

11.zh: 使者起身，来见大卫，照着约押所吩咐他的话奏告大卫。
11.en: So the messenger went, and came and showed David all that Joab had sent him for.

11.zh: 使者对大卫说：「敌人强过我们，出到郊野与我们打仗，我们追杀他们，直到城门口。
11.en: The messenger said to David, “The men prevailed against us, and came out to us into the field; and we were on them even to the entrance of the gate.

11.zh: 射箭的从城上射王的仆人，射死几个，赫人乌利亚也死了。」
11.en: The shooters shot at your servants from off the wall; and some of the king’s servants are dead, and your servant Uriah the Hittite is also dead.”

11.zh: 王向使者说：「你告诉约押说：『不要因这事愁闷，刀剑或吞灭这人或吞灭那人，没有一定的；你只管竭力攻城，将城倾覆。』可以用这话勉励约押。」
11.en: Then David said to the messenger, “Tell Joab, ‘Don’t let this thing displease you, for the sword devours one as well as another. Make your battle stronger against the city, and overthrow it.’ Encourage him.”

11.zh: 乌利亚的妻听见丈夫乌利亚死了，就为他哀哭。
11.en: When Uriah’s wife heard that Uriah her husband was dead, she mourned for her husband.

11.zh: 哀哭的日子过了，大卫差人将她接到宫里，她就作了大卫的妻，给大卫生了一个儿子。但大卫所行的这事，耶和华甚不喜悦。
11.en: When the mourning was past, David sent and took her home to his house, and she became his wife and bore him a son. But the thing that David had done displeased the LORD.

12.zh: 耶和华差遣拿单去见大卫。拿单到了大卫那里，对他说：「在一座城里有两个人：一个是富户，一个是穷人。
12.en: The LORD sent Nathan to David. He came to him, and said to him, “There were two men in one city: the one rich, and the other poor.

12.zh: 富户有许多牛群羊群；
12.en: The rich man had very many flocks and herds,

12.zh: 穷人除了所买来养活的一只小母羊羔之外，别无所有。羊羔在他家里和他儿女一同长大，吃他所吃的，喝他所喝的，睡在他怀中，在他看来如同女儿一样。
12.en: but the poor man had nothing, except one little ewe lamb, which he had bought and raised. It grew up together with him and with his children. It ate of his own food, drank of his own cup, and lay in his bosom, and was like a daughter to him.

12.zh: 有一客人来到这富户家里；富户舍不得从自己的牛群羊群中取一只预备给客人吃，却取了那穷人的羊羔，预备给客人吃。」
12.en: A traveler came to the rich man, and he didn’t want to take of his own flock and of his own herd to prepare for the wayfaring man who had come to him, but took the poor man’s lamb and prepared it for the man who had come to him.”

12.zh: 大卫就甚恼怒那人，对拿单说：「我指着永生的耶和华起誓，行这事的人该死！
12.en: David’s anger burned hot against the man, and he said to Nathan, “As the LORD lives, the man who has done this deserves to die!

12.zh: 他必偿还羊羔四倍；因为他行这事，没有怜恤的心。」
12.en: He must restore the lamb fourfold, because he did this thing and because he had no pity!”

12.zh: 拿单对大卫说：「你就是那人！耶和华—以色列的　神如此说：『我膏你作以色列的王，救你脱离扫罗的手。
12.en: Nathan said to David, “You are the man! This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘I anointed you king over Israel, and I delivered you out of the hand of Saul.

12.zh: 我将你主人的家业赐给你，将你主人的妻交在你怀里，又将以色列和犹大家赐给你；你若还以为不足，我早就加倍地赐给你。
12.en: I gave you your master’s house and your master’s wives into your bosom, and gave you the house of Israel and of Judah; and if that would have been too little, I would have added to you many more such things.

12.zh: 你为什么藐视耶和华的命令，行他眼中看为恶的事呢？你借亚扪人的刀杀害赫人乌利亚，又娶了他的妻为妻。
12.en: Why have you despised the LORD’s word, to do that which is evil in his sight? You have struck Uriah the Hittite with the sword, have taken his wife to be your wife, and have slain him with the sword of the children of Ammon.

12.zh: 你既藐视我，娶了赫人乌利亚的妻为妻，所以刀剑必永不离开你的家。』
12.en: Now therefore the sword will never depart from your house, because you have despised me and have taken Uriah the Hittite’s wife to be your wife.’

12.zh: 耶和华如此说：『我必从你家中兴起祸患攻击你；我必在你眼前把你的妃嫔赐给别人，他在日光之下就与她们同寝。
12.en: “This is what the LORD says: ‘Behold, I will raise up evil against you out of your own house; and I will take your wives before your eyes and give them to your neighbor, and he will lie with your wives in the sight of this sun.

12.zh: 你在暗中行这事，我却要在以色列众人面前，日光之下，报应你。』」
12.en: For you did this secretly, but I will do this thing before all Israel, and before the sun.’”

12.zh: 大卫对拿单说：「我得罪耶和华了！」拿单说：「耶和华已经除掉你的罪，你必不至于死。
12.en: David said to Nathan, “I have sinned against the LORD.” Nathan said to David, “The LORD also has put away your sin. You will not die.

12.zh: 只是你行这事，叫耶和华的仇敌大得亵渎的机会，故此，你所得的孩子必定要死。」
12.en: However, because by this deed you have given great occasion to the LORD’s enemies to blaspheme, the child also who is born to you will surely die.”

12.zh: 拿单就回家去了。 耶和华击打乌利亚妻给大卫所生的孩子，使他得重病。
12.en: Then Nathan departed to his house. The LORD struck the child that Uriah’s wife bore to David, and he was very sick.

12.zh: 所以大卫为这孩子恳求　神，而且禁食，进入[内室]，终夜躺在地上。
12.en: David therefore begged God for the child; and David fasted, and went in and lay all night on the ground.

12.zh: 他家中的老臣来到他旁边，要把他从地上扶起来，他却不肯起来，也不同他们吃饭。
12.en: The elders of his house arose beside him, to raise him up from the earth; but he would not, and he didn’t eat bread with them.

12.zh: 到第七日，孩子死了。大卫的臣仆不敢告诉他孩子死了，因他们说：「孩子还活着的时候，我们劝他，他尚且不肯听我们的话，若告诉他孩子死了，岂不更加忧伤吗？」
12.en: On the seventh day, the child died. David’s servants were afraid to tell him that the child was dead, for they said, “Behold, while the child was yet alive, we spoke to him and he didn’t listen to our voice. How will he then harm himself if we tell him that the child is dead?”

12.zh: 大卫见臣仆彼此低声说话，就知道孩子死了，问臣仆说：「孩子死了吗？」他们说：「死了。」
12.en: But when David saw that his servants were whispering together, David perceived that the child was dead; and David said to his servants, “Is the child dead?” They said, “He is dead.”

12.zh: 大卫就从地上起来，沐浴，抹膏，换了衣裳，进耶和华的殿敬拜；然后回宫，吩咐人摆饭，他便吃了。
12.en: Then David arose from the earth, and washed and anointed himself, and changed his clothing; and he came into the LORD’s house, and worshiped. Then he came to his own house; and when he requested, they set bread before him and he ate.

12.zh: 臣仆问他说：「你所行的是什么意思？孩子活着的时候，你禁食哭泣；孩子死了，你倒起来吃饭。」
12.en: Then his servants said to him, “What is this that you have done? You fasted and wept for the child while he was alive, but when the child was dead, you rose up and ate bread.”

12.zh: 大卫说：「孩子还活着，我禁食哭泣；因为我想，或者耶和华怜恤我，使孩子不死也未可知。
12.en: He said, “While the child was yet alive, I fasted and wept; for I said, ‘Who knows whether the LORD will not be gracious to me, that the child may live?’

12.zh: 孩子死了，我何必禁食，我岂能使他返回呢？我必往他那里去，他却不能回我这里来。」
12.en: But now he is dead. Why should I fast? Can I bring him back again? I will go to him, but he will not return to me.”

12.zh: 大卫安慰他的妻拔示巴，与她同寝，她就生了儿子，给他起名叫所罗门。耶和华也喜爱他，
12.en: David comforted Bathsheba his wife, and went in to her, and lay with her. She bore a son, and he called his name Solomon. The LORD loved him;

12.zh: 就借先知拿单赐他一个名字，叫耶底底亚，因为耶和华[爱他]。
12.en: and he sent by the hand of Nathan the prophet, and he named him Jedidiah, for the LORD’s sake.

12.zh: 约押攻取亚扪人的京城拉巴。
12.en: Now Joab fought against Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and took the royal city.

12.zh: 约押打发使者去见大卫，说：「我攻打拉巴，取其水城。
12.en: Joab sent messengers to David, and said, “I have fought against Rabbah. Yes, I have taken the city of waters.

12.zh: 现在你要聚集其余的军兵来，安营围攻这城，恐怕我取了这城，人就以我的名叫这城。」
12.en: Now therefore gather the rest of the people together, and encamp against the city and take it; lest I take the city, and it be called by my name.”

12.zh: 于是大卫聚集众军，往拉巴去攻城，就取了这城，
12.en: David gathered all the people together and went to Rabbah, and fought against it and took it.

12.zh: 夺了亚扪人之王所戴的金冠冕，其上的金子重一他连得，又嵌着宝石。人将这冠冕戴在大卫头上。大卫从城里夺了许多财物，
12.en: He took the crown of their king from off his head; and its weight was a talent of gold, and in it were precious stones; and it was set on David’s head. He brought a great quantity of plunder out of the city.

12.zh: 将城里的人拉出来，放在锯下，或铁耙下，或铁斧下，或叫他经过砖窑；大卫待亚扪各城的居民都是如此。其后，大卫和众军都回耶路撒冷去了。
12.en: He brought out the people who were in it, and put them to work under saws, under iron picks, under axes of iron, and made them go to the brick kiln; and he did so to all the cities of the children of Ammon. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.

13.zh: 大卫的儿子押沙龙有一个美貌的妹子，名叫她玛。大卫的儿子暗嫩爱她。
13.en: After this, Absalom the son of David had a beautiful sister, whose name was Tamar; and Amnon the son of David loved her.

13.zh: 暗嫩为他妹子她玛忧急成病。她玛还是处女，暗嫩以为难向她行事。
13.en: Amnon was so troubled that he became sick because of his sister Tamar, for she was a virgin, and it seemed hard to Amnon to do anything to her.

13.zh: 暗嫩有一个朋友，名叫约拿达，是大卫长兄示米亚的儿子。这约拿达为人极其狡猾；
13.en: But Amnon had a friend whose name was Jonadab the son of Shimeah, David’s brother; and Jonadab was a very subtle man.

13.zh: 他问暗嫩说：「王的儿子啊，为何一天比一天瘦弱呢？请你告诉我。」暗嫩回答说：「我爱我兄弟押沙龙的妹子她玛。」
13.en: He said to him, “Why, son of the king, are you so sad from day to day? Won’t you tell me?” Amnon said to him, “I love Tamar, my brother Absalom’s sister.”

13.zh: 约拿达说：「你不如躺在床上装病；你父亲来看你，就对他说：『求父叫我妹子她玛来，在我眼前预备食物，递给我吃，使我看见，好从她手里接过来吃。』」
13.en: Jonadab said to him, “Lay down on your bed and pretend to be sick. When your father comes to see you, tell him, ‘Please let my sister Tamar come and give me bread to eat, and prepare the food in my sight, that I may see it and eat it from her hand.’”

13.zh: 于是暗嫩躺卧装病。王来看他，他对王说：「求父叫我妹子她玛来，在我眼前为我做两个饼，我好从她手里接过来吃。」
13.en: So Amnon lay down and faked being sick. When the king came to see him, Amnon said to the king, “Please let my sister Tamar come and make me a couple of cakes in my sight, that I may eat from her hand.”

13.zh: 大卫就打发人到宫里，对她玛说：「你往你哥哥暗嫩的屋里去，为他预备食物。」
13.en: Then David sent home to Tamar, saying, “Go now to your brother Amnon’s house, and prepare food for him.”

13.zh: 她玛就到她哥哥暗嫩的屋里；暗嫩正躺卧。她玛抟面，在他眼前做饼，且烤熟了，
13.en: So Tamar went to her brother Amnon’s house; and he was lying down. She took dough, kneaded it, made cakes in his sight, and baked the cakes.

13.zh: 在他面前将饼从锅里倒出来，他却不肯吃，便说：「众人离开我出去吧！」众人就都离开他，出去了。
13.en: She took the pan and poured them out before him, but he refused to eat. Amnon said, “Have all men leave me.” Then every man went out from him.

13.zh: 暗嫩对她玛说：「你把食物拿进卧房，我好从你手里接过来吃。」她玛就把所做的饼拿进卧房，到她哥哥暗嫩那里，
13.en: Amnon said to Tamar, “Bring the food into the room, that I may eat from your hand.” Tamar took the cakes which she had made, and brought them into the room to Amnon her brother.

13.zh: 拿着饼上前给他吃，他便拉住她玛，说：「我妹妹，你来与我同寝。」
13.en: When she had brought them near to him to eat, he took hold of her and said to her, “Come, lie with me, my sister!”

13.zh: 她玛说：「我哥哥，不要玷辱我。以色列人中不当这样行，你不要做这丑事；
13.en: She answered him, “No, my brother, do not force me! For no such thing ought to be done in Israel. Don’t you do this folly!

13.zh: 你[玷辱了我]，我何以掩盖我的羞耻呢？你在以色列中也成了愚妄人。你可以求王，他必不禁止我归你。」
13.en: As for me, where would I carry my shame? And as for you, you will be as one of the fools in Israel. Now therefore, please speak to the king; for he will not withhold me from you.”

13.zh: 但暗嫩不肯听她的话，因比她力大，就玷辱她，与她同寝。
13.en: However, he would not listen to her voice; but being stronger than she, he forced her and lay with her.

13.zh: 随后，暗嫩极其恨她，那恨她的心比先前爱她的心更甚，对她说：「你起来，去吧！」
13.en: Then Amnon hated her with exceedingly great hatred; for the hatred with which he hated her was greater than the love with which he had loved her. Amnon said to her, “Arise, be gone!”

13.zh: 她玛说：「不要这样！你赶出我去的这罪比你才行的更重！」但暗嫩不肯听她的话，
13.en: She said to him, “Not so, because this great wrong in sending me away is worse than the other that you did to me!” But he would not listen to her.

13.zh: 就叫伺候自己的仆人来，说：「将这个女子赶出去！她一出去，你就关门，上闩。」
13.en: Then he called his servant who ministered to him, and said, “Now put this woman out from me, and bolt the door after her.”

13.zh: 那时她玛穿着彩衣，因为没有出嫁的公主都是这样穿。暗嫩的仆人就把她赶出去，关门上闩。
13.en: She had a garment of various colors on her, for the king’s daughters who were virgins dressed in such robes. Then his servant brought her out and bolted the door after her.

13.zh: 她玛把灰尘撒在头上，撕裂所穿的彩衣，以手抱头，一面行走，一面哭喊。
13.en: Tamar put ashes on her head, and tore her garment of various colors that was on her; and she laid her hand on her head and went her way, crying aloud as she went.

13.zh: 她胞兄押沙龙问她说：「莫非你哥哥暗嫩与你亲近了吗？我妹妹，暂且不要作声，他是你的哥哥，不要将这事放在心上。」她玛就孤孤单单地住在她胞兄押沙龙家里。
13.en: Absalom her brother said to her, “Has Amnon your brother been with you? But now hold your peace, my sister. He is your brother. Don’t take this thing to heart.” So Tamar remained desolate in her brother Absalom’s house.

13.zh: 大卫王听见这事，就甚发怒。
13.en: But when King David heard of all these things, he was very angry.

13.zh: 押沙龙并不和他哥哥暗嫩说好说歹；因为暗嫩玷辱他妹妹她玛，所以押沙龙恨恶他。
13.en: Absalom spoke to Amnon neither good nor bad; for Absalom hated Amnon, because he had forced his sister Tamar.

13.zh: 过了二年，在靠近以法莲的巴力·夏琐有人为押沙龙剪羊毛；押沙龙请王的众子与他同去。
13.en: After two full years, Absalom had sheep shearers in Baal Hazor, which is beside Ephraim; and Absalom invited all the king’s sons.

13.zh: 押沙龙来见王，说：「现在有人为仆人剪羊毛，请王和王的臣仆与仆人同去。」
13.en: Absalom came to the king and said, “See now, your servant has sheep shearers. Please let the king and his servants go with your servant.”

13.zh: 王对押沙龙说：「我儿，我们不必都去，恐怕使你耗费太多。」押沙龙再三请王，王仍是不肯去，只为他祝福。
13.en: The king said to Absalom, “No, my son, let’s not all go, lest we be burdensome to you.” He pressed him; however he would not go, but blessed him.

13.zh: 押沙龙说：「王若不去，求王许我哥哥暗嫩同去。」王说：「何必要他去呢？」
13.en: Then Absalom said, “If not, please let my brother Amnon go with us.” The king said to him, “Why should he go with you?”

13.zh: 押沙龙再三求王，王就许暗嫩和王的众子与他同去。
13.en: But Absalom pressed him, and he let Amnon and all the king’s sons go with him.

13.zh: 押沙龙吩咐仆人说：「你们注意，看暗嫩饮酒畅快的时候，我对你们说杀暗嫩，你们便杀他，不要惧怕。这不是我吩咐你们的吗？你们只管壮胆奋勇！」
13.en: Absalom commanded his servants, saying, “Mark now, when Amnon’s heart is merry with wine; and when I tell you, ‘Strike Amnon,’ then kill him. Don’t be afraid. Haven’t I commanded you? Be courageous, and be valiant!”

13.zh: 押沙龙的仆人就照押沙龙所吩咐的，向暗嫩行了。王的众子都起来，各人骑上骡子，逃跑了。
13.en: The servants of Absalom did to Amnon as Absalom had commanded. Then all the king’s sons arose, and every man got up on his mule and fled.

13.zh: 他们还在路上，有风声传到大卫那里，说：「押沙龙将王的众子都杀了，没有留下一个。」
13.en: While they were on the way, the news came to David, saying, “Absalom has slain all the king’s sons, and there is not one of them left!”

13.zh: 王就起来，撕裂衣服，躺在地上。王的臣仆也都撕裂衣服，站在旁边。
13.en: Then the king arose, and tore his garments, and lay on the earth; and all his servants stood by with their clothes torn.

13.zh: 大卫的长兄，示米亚的儿子约拿达说：「我主，不要以为王的众子—少年人都杀了，只有暗嫩一个人死了。自从暗嫩玷辱押沙龙妹子她玛的那日，押沙龙就定意杀暗嫩了。
13.en: Jonadab the son of Shimeah, David’s brother, answered, “Don’t let my lord suppose that they have killed all the young men, the king’s sons, for Amnon only is dead; for by the appointment of Absalom this has been determined from the day that he forced his sister Tamar.

13.zh: 现在，我主我王，不要把这事放在心上，以为王的众子都死了，只有暗嫩一个人死了。」
13.en: Now therefore don’t let my lord the king take the thing to his heart, to think that all the king’s sons are dead; for only Amnon is dead.”

13.zh: 押沙龙逃跑了。 守望的少年人举目观看，见有许多人从山坡的路上来。
13.en: But Absalom fled. The young man who kept the watch lifted up his eyes and looked, and behold, many people were coming by way of the hillside behind him.

13.zh: 约拿达对王说：「看哪，王的众子都来了，果然与你仆人所说的相合。」
13.en: Jonadab said to the king, “Behold, the king’s sons are coming! It is as your servant said.”

13.zh: 话才说完，王的众子都到了，放声大哭；王和臣仆也都哭得甚恸。
13.en: As soon as he had finished speaking, behold, the king’s sons came, and lifted up their voices and wept. The king also and all his servants wept bitterly.

13.zh: 押沙龙逃到基述王亚米忽的儿子达买那里去了。大卫天天为他儿子悲哀。
13.en: But Absalom fled and went to Talmai the son of Ammihur, king of Geshur. David mourned for his son every day.

13.zh: 押沙龙逃到基述，在那里住了三年。
13.en: So Absalom fled and went to Geshur, and was there three years.

13.zh: 暗嫩死了以后，大卫王得了安慰，心里切切想念押沙龙。
13.en: King David longed to go out to Absalom, for he was comforted concerning Amnon, since he was dead.

14.zh: 洗鲁雅的儿子约押，知道王心里想念押沙龙，
14.en: Now Joab the son of Zeruiah perceived that the king’s heart was toward Absalom.

14.zh: 就打发人往提哥亚去，从那里叫了一个聪明的妇人来，对她说：「请你假装居丧的，穿上孝衣，不要用膏抹身，要装作为死者许久悲哀的妇人；
14.en: Joab sent to Tekoa and brought a wise woman from there, and said to her, “Please act like a mourner, and put on mourning clothing, please, and don’t anoint yourself with oil; but be as a woman who has mourned a long time for the dead.

14.zh: 进去见王，对王如此如此说。」于是约押将当说的话教导了妇人。
14.en: Go in to the king and speak like this to him.” So Joab put the words in her mouth.

14.zh: 提哥亚妇人到王面前，伏地叩拜，说：「王啊，求你拯救！」
14.en: When the woman of Tekoa spoke to the king, she fell on her face to the ground, showed respect, and said, “Help, O king!”

14.zh: 王问她说：「你有什么事呢？」回答说：「婢女实在是寡妇，我丈夫死了。
14.en: The king said to her, “What ails you?” She answered, “Truly I am a widow, and my husband is dead.

14.zh: 我有两个儿子，一日在田间争斗，没有人解劝，这个就打死那个。
14.en: Your servant had two sons; and they both fought together in the field, and there was no one to part them, but the one struck the other and killed him.

14.zh: 现在全家的人都起来攻击婢女，说：『你将那打死兄弟的交出来，我们好治死他，偿他打死兄弟的命，灭绝那承受家业的。』这样，他们要将我剩下的炭火灭尽，不与我丈夫留名留后在世上。」
14.en: Behold, the whole family has risen against your servant, and they say, ‘Deliver him who struck his brother, that we may kill him for the life of his brother whom he killed, and so destroy the heir also.’ Thus they would quench my coal which is left, and would leave to my husband neither name nor remainder on the surface of the earth.”

14.zh: 王对妇人说：「你回家去吧！我必为你下令。」
14.en: The king said to the woman, “Go to your house, and I will give a command concerning you.”

14.zh: 提哥亚妇人又对王说：「我主我王，愿这罪归我和我父家，与王和王的位无干。」
14.en: The woman of Tekoa said to the king, “My lord, O king, may the iniquity be on me, and on my father’s house; and may the king and his throne be guiltless.”

14.zh: 王说：「凡难为你的，你就带他到我这里来，他必不再搅扰你。」
14.en: The king said, “Whoever says anything to you, bring him to me, and he will not bother you any more.”

14.zh: 妇人说：「愿王记念耶和华—你的　神，不许报血仇的人施行灭绝，恐怕他们灭绝我的儿子。」王说：「我指着永生的耶和华起誓：你的儿子连一根头发也不致落在地上。」
14.en: Then she said, “Please let the king remember the LORD your God, that the avenger of blood destroy not any more, lest they destroy my son.” He said, “As the LORD lives, not one hair of your son shall fall to the earth.”

14.zh: 妇人说：「求我主我王容婢女再说一句话。」王说：「你说吧！」
14.en: Then the woman said, “Please let your servant speak a word to my lord the king.” He said, “Say on.”

14.zh: 妇人说：「王为何也起意要害　神的民呢？王不使那逃亡的人回来，王的这话就是自证己错了！
14.en: The woman said, “Why then have you devised such a thing against the people of God? For in speaking this word the king is as one who is guilty, in that the king does not bring home again his banished one.

14.zh: 我们都是必死的，如同水泼在地上，不能收回。　神并不夺取人的性命，乃设法使逃亡的人不致成为赶出、回不来的。
14.en: For we must die, and are like water spilled on the ground, which can’t be gathered up again; neither does God take away life, but devises means, that he who is banished not be an outcast from him.

14.zh: 我来将这话告诉我主我王，是因百姓使我惧怕。婢女想，不如将这话告诉王，或者王成就婢女所求的。
14.en: Now therefore, seeing that I have come to speak this word to my lord the king, it is because the people have made me afraid. Your servant said, ‘I will now speak to the king; it may be that the king will perform the request of his servant.’

14.zh: 人要将我和我儿子从　神的地业上一同除灭，王必应允救我脱离他的手。
14.en: For the king will hear, to deliver his servant out of the hand of the man who would destroy me and my son together out of the inheritance of God.

14.zh: 婢女又想，我主我王的话必安慰我；因为我主我王能辨别是非，如同　神的使者一样。惟愿耶和华—你的　神与你同在！」
14.en: Then your servant said, ‘Please let the word of my lord the king bring rest; for as an angel of God, so is my lord the king to discern good and bad. May the LORD, your God, be with you.’”

14.zh: 王对妇人说：「我要问你一句话，你一点不要瞒我。」妇人说：「愿我主我王说。」
14.en: Then the king answered the woman, “Please don’t hide anything from me that I ask you.” The woman said, “Let my lord the king now speak.”

14.zh: 王说：「你这些话莫非是约押的主意吗？」妇人说：「我敢在我主我王面前起誓：王的话正对，不偏左右，是王的仆人约押吩咐我的，这些话是他教导我的。
14.en: The king said, “Is the hand of Joab with you in all this?” The woman answered, “As your soul lives, my lord the king, no one can turn to the right hand or to the left from anything that my lord the king has spoken; for your servant Joab urged me, and he put all these words in the mouth of your servant.

14.zh: 王的仆人约押如此行，为要挽回这事。我主的智慧却如　神使者的智慧，能知世上一切事。」
14.en: Your servant Joab has done this thing to change the face of the matter. My lord is wise, according to the wisdom of an angel of God, to know all things that are on the earth.”

14.zh: 王对约押说：「我应允你这事。你可以去，把那少年人押沙龙带回来。」
14.en: The king said to Joab, “Behold now, I have granted this thing. Go therefore, and bring the young man Absalom back.”

14.zh: 约押就面伏于地叩拜，祝谢于王，又说：「王既应允仆人所求的，仆人今日知道在我主我王眼前蒙恩了。」
14.en: Joab fell to the ground on his face, showed respect, and blessed the king. Joab said, “Today your servant knows that I have found favor in your sight, my lord, O king, in that the king has performed the request of his servant.”

14.zh: 于是约押起身往基述去，将押沙龙带回耶路撒冷。
14.en: So Joab arose and went to Geshur, and brought Absalom to Jerusalem.

14.zh: 王说：「使他回自己家里去，不要见我的面。」押沙龙就回自己家里去，没有见王的面。
14.en: The king said, “Let him return to his own house, but let him not see my face.” So Absalom returned to his own house, and didn’t see the king’s face.

14.zh: 以色列全地之中，无人像押沙龙那样俊美，得人的称赞，从脚底到头顶毫无瑕疵。
14.en: Now in all Israel there was no one to be so much praised as Absalom for his beauty. From the sole of his foot even to the crown of his head there was no defect in him.

14.zh: 他的头发甚重，每到年底剪发一次；所剪下来的，按王的平称一称，重二百舍客勒。
14.en: When he cut the hair of his head (now it was at every year’s end that he cut it; because it was heavy on him, therefore he cut it), he weighed the hair of his head at two hundred shekels, after the king’s weight.

14.zh: 押沙龙生了三个儿子，一个女儿。女儿名叫她玛，是个容貌俊美的女子。
14.en: Three sons were born to Absalom, and one daughter, whose name was Tamar. She was a woman with a beautiful face.

14.zh: 押沙龙住在耶路撒冷足有二年，没有见王的面。
14.en: Absalom lived two full years in Jerusalem, and he didn’t see the king’s face.

14.zh: 押沙龙打发人去叫约押来，要托他去见王，约押却不肯来。第二次打发人去叫他，他仍不肯来。
14.en: Then Absalom sent for Joab, to send him to the king, but he would not come to him. Then he sent again a second time, but he would not come.

14.zh: 所以押沙龙对仆人说：「你们看，约押有一块田，与我的田相近，其中有大麦，你们去放火烧了。」押沙龙的仆人就去放火烧了那田。
14.en: Therefore he said to his servants, “Behold, Joab’s field is near mine, and he has barley there. Go and set it on fire.” So Absalom’s servants set the field on fire.

14.zh: 于是约押起来，到了押沙龙家里，问他说：「你的仆人为何放火烧了我的田呢？」
14.en: Then Joab arose and came to Absalom to his house, and said to him, “Why have your servants set my field on fire?”

14.zh: 押沙龙回答约押说：「我打发人去请你来，好托你去见王，替我说：『我为何从基述回来呢？不如仍在那里。』现在要许我见王的面；我若有罪，任凭王杀我就是了。」
14.en: Absalom answered Joab, “Behold, I sent to you, saying, ‘Come here, that I may send you to the king, to say, “Why have I come from Geshur? It would be better for me to be there still. Now therefore, let me see the king’s face; and if there is iniquity in me, let him kill me.”’”

14.zh: 于是约押去见王，将这话奏告王，王便叫押沙龙来。押沙龙来见王，在王面前俯伏于地，王就与押沙龙亲嘴。
14.en: So Joab came to the king and told him; and when he had called for Absalom, he came to the king and bowed himself on his face to the ground before the king; and the king kissed Absalom.

15.zh: 此后，押沙龙为自己预备车马，又派五十人在他前头奔走。
15.en: After this, Absalom prepared a chariot and horses for himself, and fifty men to run before him.

15.zh: 押沙龙常常早晨起来，站在城门的道旁，凡有争讼要去求王判断的，押沙龙就叫他过来，问他说：「你是哪一城的人？」回答说：「仆人是以色列某支派的人。」
15.en: Absalom rose up early, and stood beside the way of the gate. When any man had a suit which should come to the king for judgment, then Absalom called to him, and said, “What city are you from?” He said, “Your servant is of one of the tribes of Israel.”

15.zh: 押沙龙对他说：「你的事有情有理，无奈王没有委人听你伸诉。」
15.en: Absalom said to him, “Behold, your matters are good and right; but there is no man deputized by the king to hear you.”

15.zh: 押沙龙又说：「恨不得我作国中的士师！凡有争讼求审判的到我这里来，我必秉公判断。」
15.en: Absalom said moreover, “Oh that I were made judge in the land, that every man who has any suit or cause might come to me, and I would do him justice!”

15.zh: 若有人近前来要拜押沙龙，押沙龙就伸手拉住他，与他亲嘴。
15.en: It was so, that when any man came near to bow down to him, he stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and kissed him.

15.zh: 以色列人中，凡去见王求判断的，押沙龙都是如此待他们。这样，押沙龙暗中得了以色列人的心。
15.en: Absalom did this sort of thing to all Israel who came to the king for judgment. So Absalom stole the hearts of the men of Israel.

15.zh: 满了四十年，押沙龙对王说：「求你准我往希伯 去，还我向耶和华所许的愿。
15.en: At the end of forty years, Absalom said to the king, “Please let me go and pay my vow, which I have vowed to the LORD, in Hebron.

15.zh: 因为仆人住在亚兰的基述，曾许愿说：『耶和华若使我再回耶路撒冷，我必事奉他。』」
15.en: For your servant vowed a vow while I stayed at Geshur in Syria, saying, ‘If the LORD shall indeed bring me again to Jerusalem, then I will serve the LORD.’”

15.zh: 王说：「你平平安安地去吧！」押沙龙就起身，往希伯 去了。
15.en: The king said to him, “Go in peace.” So he arose and went to Hebron.

15.zh: 押沙龙打发探子走遍以色列各支派，说：「你们一听见角声就说：『押沙龙在希伯 作王了！』」
15.en: But Absalom sent spies throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, “As soon as you hear the sound of the trumpet, then you shall say, ‘Absalom is king in Hebron!’”

15.zh: 押沙龙在耶路撒冷请了二百人与他同去，都是诚诚实实去的，并不知道其中的真情。
15.en: Two hundred men went with Absalom out of Jerusalem, who were invited, and went in their simplicity; and they didn’t know anything.

15.zh: 押沙龙献祭的时候，打发人去将大卫的谋士、基罗人亚希多弗从他本城请了来。于是叛逆的势派甚大；因为随从押沙龙的人民，日渐增多。
15.en: Absalom sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite, David’s counselor, from his city, even from Giloh, while he was offering the sacrifices. The conspiracy was strong, for the people increased continually with Absalom.

15.zh: 有人报告大卫说：「以色列人的心都归向押沙龙了！」
15.en: A messenger came to David, saying, “The hearts of the men of Israel are after Absalom.”

15.zh: 大卫就对耶路撒冷跟随他的臣仆说：「我们要起来逃走，不然都不能躲避押沙龙了；要速速地去，恐怕他忽然来到，加害于我们，用刀杀尽合城的人。」
15.en: David said to all his servants who were with him at Jerusalem, “Arise! Let’s flee, or else none of us will escape from Absalom. Hurry to depart, lest he overtake us quickly and bring down evil on us, and strike the city with the edge of the sword.”

15.zh: 王的臣仆对王说：「我主我王所定的，仆人都愿遵行。」
15.en: The king’s servants said to the king, “Behold, your servants are ready to do whatever my lord the king chooses.”

15.zh: 于是王带着全家的人出去了，但留下十个妃嫔看守宫殿。
15.en: The king went out, and all his household after him. The king left ten women, who were concubines, to keep the house.

15.zh: 王出去，众民都跟随他，到伯·墨哈，就住下了。
15.en: The king went out, and all the people after him; and they stayed in Beth Merhak.

15.zh: 王的臣仆都在他面前过去。基利提人、比利提人，就是从迦特跟随王来的六百人，也都在他面前过去。
15.en: All his servants passed on beside him; and all the Cherethites, and all the Pelethites, and all the Gittites, six hundred men who came after him from Gath, passed on before the king.

15.zh: 王对迦特人以太说：「你是外邦逃来的人，为什么与我们同去呢？你可以回去与[新]王同住，[或者回]你本地去吧！
15.en: Then the king said to Ittai the Gittite, “Why do you also go with us? Return, and stay with the king; for you are a foreigner and also an exile. Return to your own place.

15.zh: 你来的日子不多，我今日怎好叫你与我们一同飘流、没有一定的住处呢？你不如带你的弟兄回去吧！[愿耶和华]用慈爱诚实待你。」
15.en: Whereas you came but yesterday, should I today make you go up and down with us, since I go where I may? Return, and take back your brothers. Mercy and truth be with you.”

15.zh: 以太对王说：「我指着永生的耶和华起誓，又敢在王面前起誓：无论生死，王在哪里，仆人也必在那里。」
15.en: Ittai answered the king and said, “As the LORD lives, and as my lord the king lives, surely in what place my lord the king is, whether for death or for life, your servant will be there also.”

15.zh: 大卫对以太说：「你前去过[河]吧！」于是迦特人以太带着跟随他的人和所有的[妇人]孩子，就都过去了。
15.en: David said to Ittai, “Go and pass over.” Ittai the Gittite passed over, and all his men, and all the little ones who were with him.

15.zh: 本地的人都放声大哭。众民尽都过去，王也过了汲沦溪；众民往旷野去了。
15.en: All the country wept with a loud voice, and all the people passed over. The king also himself passed over the brook Kidron, and all the people passed over toward the way of the wilderness.

15.zh: 撒督和抬　神约柜的利未人也一同来了，将　神的[约]柜放下。亚比亚他上来，等着众民从城里出来过去。
15.en: Behold, Zadok also came, and all the Levites with him, bearing the ark of the covenant of God; and they set down God’s ark; and Abiathar went up until all the people finished passing out of the city.

15.zh: 王对撒督说：「你将　神的[约]柜抬回城去。我若在耶和华眼前蒙恩，他必使我回来，再见[约]柜和他的居所。
15.en: The king said to Zadok, “Carry God’s ark back into the city. If I find favor in the LORD’s eyes, he will bring me again, and show me both it and his habitation;

15.zh: 倘若他说：『我不喜悦你』，看哪，我在这里，愿他凭自己的意旨待我！」
15.en: but if he says, ‘I have no delight in you,’ behold, here I am. Let him do to me as seems good to him.”

15.zh: 王又对祭司撒督说：「你不是先见吗？你可以安然回城；你儿子亚希玛斯和亚比亚他的儿子约拿单都可以与你同去。
15.en: The king said also to Zadok the priest, “Aren’t you a seer? Return into the city in peace, and your two sons with you, Ahimaaz your son and Jonathan the son of Abiathar.

15.zh: 我在旷野的渡口那里等你们报信给我。」
15.en: Behold, I will stay at the fords of the wilderness until word comes from you to inform me.”

15.zh: 于是撒督和亚比亚他将　神的[约]柜抬回耶路撒冷，他们就住在那里。
15.en: Zadok therefore and Abiathar carried God’s ark to Jerusalem again; and they stayed there.

15.zh: 大卫蒙头赤脚上橄榄山，一面上一面哭。跟随他的人也都蒙头哭着上去；
15.en: David went up by the ascent of the Mount of Olives, and wept as he went up; and he had his head covered and went barefoot. All the people who were with him each covered his head, and they went up, weeping as they went up.

15.zh: 有人告诉大卫说：「亚希多弗也在叛党之中，随从押沙龙。」大卫祷告说：「耶和华啊，求你使亚希多弗的计谋变为愚拙！」
15.en: Someone told David, saying, “Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom.” David said, “LORD, please turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness.”

15.zh: 大卫到了[山]顶、敬拜　神的地方，见亚基人户筛，衣服撕裂，头蒙灰尘来迎接他。
15.en: When David had come to the top, where God was worshiped, behold, Hushai the Archite came to meet him with his tunic torn and earth on his head.

15.zh: 大卫对他说：「你若与我同去，必累赘我；
15.en: David said to him, “If you pass on with me, then you will be a burden to me;

15.zh: 你若回城去，对押沙龙说：『王啊，我愿作你的仆人；我向来作你父亲的仆人，现在我也照样作你的仆人。』这样，你就可以为我破坏亚希多弗的计谋。
