15.en: but if you return to the city, and tell Absalom, ‘I will be your servant, O king. As I have been your father’s servant in time past, so I will now be your servant; then you will defeat for me the counsel of Ahithophel.’

15.zh: 祭司撒督和亚比亚他岂不都在那里吗？你在王宫里听见什么，就要告诉祭司撒督和亚比亚他。
15.en: Don’t you have Zadok and Abiathar the priests there with you? Therefore whatever you hear out of the king’s house, tell it to Zadok and Abiathar the priests.

15.zh: 撒督的儿子亚希玛斯，亚比亚他的儿子约拿单，也都在那里。凡你们所听见的可以托这二人来报告我。」
15.en: Behold, they have there with them their two sons, Ahimaaz, Zadok’s son, and Jonathan, Abiathar’s son. Send to me everything that you shall hear by them.”

15.zh: 于是，大卫的朋友户筛进了城；押沙龙也进了耶路撒冷。
15.en: So Hushai, David’s friend, came into the city; and Absalom came into Jerusalem.

16.zh: 大卫刚过[山]顶，见米非波设的仆人洗巴拉着备好了的两匹驴，驴上驮着二百面饼，一百葡萄饼，一百个夏天的果饼，一皮袋酒来迎接他。
16.en: When David was a little past the top, behold, Ziba the servant of Mephibosheth met him with a couple of donkeys saddled, and on them two hundred loaves of bread, and one hundred clusters of raisins, and one hundred summer fruits, and a container of wine.

16.zh: 王问洗巴说：「你带这些来是什么意思呢？」洗巴说：「驴是给王的家眷骑的；面饼和夏天的果饼是给少年人吃的；酒是给在旷野疲乏人喝的。」
16.en: The king said to Ziba, “What do you mean by these?” Ziba said, “The donkeys are for the king’s household to ride on; and the bread and summer fruit for the young men to eat; and the wine, that those who are faint in the wilderness may drink.”

16.zh: 王问说：「你主人的儿子在哪里呢？」洗巴回答王说：「他仍在耶路撒冷，因他说：『以色列人今日必将我父的国归还我。』」
16.en: The king said, “Where is your master’s son?” Ziba said to the king, “Behold, he is staying in Jerusalem; for he said, ‘Today the house of Israel will restore me the kingdom of my father.’”

16.zh: 王对洗巴说：「凡属米非波设的都归你了。」洗巴说：「我叩拜我主我王，愿我在你眼前蒙恩。」
16.en: Then the king said to Ziba, “Behold, all that belongs to Mephibosheth is yours.” Ziba said, “I bow down. Let me find favor in your sight, my lord, O king.”

16.zh: 大卫王到了巴户琳，见有一个人出来，是扫罗族基拉的儿子，名叫示每。他一面走一面咒骂，
16.en: When King David came to Bahurim, behold, a man of the family of Saul’s house came out, whose name was Shimei, the son of Gera. He came out and cursed as he came.

16.zh: 又拿石头砍大卫王和王的臣仆；众民和勇士都在王的左右。
16.en: He cast stones at David and at all the servants of King David, and all the people and all the mighty men were on his right hand and on his left.

16.zh: 示每咒骂说：「你这流人血的坏人哪，去吧去吧！
16.en: Shimei said when he cursed, “Be gone, be gone, you man of blood, and wicked fellow!

16.zh: 你流扫罗全家的血，接续他作王；耶和华把这罪归在你身上，将这国交给你儿子押沙龙。现在你自取其祸，因为你是流人血的人。」
16.en: The LORD has returned on you all the blood of Saul’s house, in whose place you have reigned! The LORD has delivered the kingdom into the hand of Absalom your son! Behold, you are caught by your own mischief, because you are a man of blood!”

16.zh: 洗鲁雅的儿子亚比筛对王说：「这死狗岂可咒骂我主我王呢？求你容我过去，割下他的头来。」
16.en: Then Abishai the son of Zeruiah said to the king, “Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king? Please let me go over and take off his head.”

16.zh: 王说：「洗鲁雅的儿子，我与你们有何关涉呢？他咒骂是因耶和华吩咐他说：『你要咒骂大卫。』如此，谁敢说你为什么这样行呢？」
16.en: The king said, “What have I to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah? Because he curses, and because the LORD has said to him, ‘Curse David,’ who then shall say, ‘Why have you done so?’”

16.zh: 大卫又对亚比筛和众臣仆说：「我亲生的儿子尚且寻索我的性命，何况这便雅悯人呢？由他咒骂吧！因为这是耶和华吩咐他的。
16.en: David said to Abishai and to all his servants, “Behold, my son, who came out of my bowels, seeks my life. How much more this Benjamite, now? Leave him alone, and let him curse; for the LORD has invited him.

16.zh: 或者耶和华见我遭难，为我今日被这人咒骂，就施恩与我。」
16.en: It may be that the LORD will look on the wrong done to me, and that the LORD will repay me good for the cursing of me today.”

16.zh: 于是大卫和跟随他的人往前行走。示每在大卫对面山坡，一面行走一面咒骂，又拿石头砍他，拿土扬他。
16.en: So David and his men went by the way; and Shimei went along on the hillside opposite him and cursed as he went, threw stones at him, and threw dust.

16.zh: 王和跟随他的众人疲疲乏乏地到了一个地方，就在那里歇息歇息。
16.en: The king and all the people who were with him arrived weary; and he refreshed himself there.

16.zh: 押沙龙和以色列众人来到耶路撒冷；亚希多弗也与他同来。
16.en: Absalom and all the people, the men of Israel, came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel with him.

16.zh: 大卫的朋友亚基人户筛去见押沙龙，对他说：「愿王万岁！愿王万岁！」
16.en: When Hushai the Archite, David’s friend, had come to Absalom, Hushai said to Absalom, “Long live the king! Long live the king!”

16.zh: 押沙龙问户筛说：「这是你恩待朋友吗？为什么不与你的朋友同去呢？」
16.en: Absalom said to Hushai, “Is this your kindness to your friend? Why didn’t you go with your friend?”

16.zh: 户筛对押沙龙说：「不然，耶和华和这民，并以色列众人所拣选的，我必归顺他，与他同住。
16.en: Hushai said to Absalom, “No; but whomever the LORD and this people and all the men of Israel have chosen, I will be his, and I will stay with him.

16.zh: 再者，我当服事谁呢？岂不是前王的儿子吗？我怎样服事你父亲，也必照样服事你。」
16.en: Again, whom should I serve? Shouldn’t I serve in the presence of his son? As I have served in your father’s presence, so I will be in your presence.”

16.zh: 押沙龙对亚希多弗说：「你们出个主意，我们怎样行才好？」
16.en: Then Absalom said to Ahithophel, “Give your counsel what we shall do.”

16.zh: 亚希多弗对押沙龙说：「你父所留下看守宫殿的妃嫔，你可以与她们亲近。以色列众人听见你父亲憎恶你，凡归顺你人的手就更坚强。」
16.en: Ahithophel said to Absalom, “Go in to your father’s concubines that he has left to keep the house. Then all Israel will hear that you are abhorred by your father. Then the hands of all who are with you will be strong.”

16.zh: 于是人为押沙龙在宫殿的平顶上支搭帐棚；押沙龙在以色列众人眼前，与他父的妃嫔亲近。
16.en: So they spread a tent for Absalom on the top of the house, and Absalom went in to his father’s concubines in the sight of all Israel.

16.zh: 那时亚希多弗所出的主意好像人问　神的话一样；他昔日给大卫，今日给押沙龙所出的主意，都是这样。
16.en: The counsel of Ahithophel, which he gave in those days, was as if a man inquired at the inner sanctuary of God. All the counsel of Ahithophel was like this both with David and with Absalom.

17.zh: 亚希多弗又对押沙龙说：「求你准我挑选一万二千人，今夜我就起身追赶大卫，
17.en: Moreover Ahithophel said to Absalom, “Let me now choose twelve thousand men, and I will arise and pursue after David tonight.

17.zh: 趁他疲乏手软，我忽然追上他，使他惊惶；跟随他的民必都逃跑，我就单杀王一人，
17.en: I will come on him while he is weary and exhausted, and will make him afraid. All the people who are with him will flee. I will strike the king only,

17.zh: 使众民都归顺你。你所寻找的人[既然死了]，众民就如已经归顺你；这样，也都平安无事了。」
17.en: and I will bring back all the people to you. The man whom you seek is as if all returned. All the people shall be in peace.”

17.zh: 押沙龙和以色列的长老都以这话为美。
17.en: The saying pleased Absalom well, and all the elders of Israel.

17.zh: 押沙龙说：「要召亚基人户筛来，我们也要听他怎样说。」
17.en: Then Absalom said, “Now call Hushai the Archite also, and let’s hear likewise what he says.”

17.zh: 户筛到了押沙龙面前，押沙龙向他说：「亚希多弗是如此如此说的，我们照着他的话行可以不可以？若不可，你就说吧！」
17.en: When Hushai had come to Absalom, Absalom spoke to him, saying, “Ahithophel has spoken like this. Shall we do what he says? If not, speak up.”

17.zh: 户筛对押沙龙说：「亚希多弗这次所定的谋不善。」
17.en: Hushai said to Absalom, “The counsel that Ahithophel has given this time is not good.”

17.zh: 户筛又说：「你知道，你父亲和跟随他的人都是勇士，现在他们心里恼怒，如同田野丢崽子的母熊一般，而且你父亲是个战士，必不和民一同住宿。
17.en: Hushai said moreover, “You know your father and his men, that they are mighty men, and they are fierce in their minds, like a bear robbed of her cubs in the field. Your father is a man of war, and will not lodge with the people.

17.zh: 他现今或藏在坑中或在别处，若有人首先被杀，凡听见的必说：『跟随押沙龙的民被杀了。』
17.en: Behold, he is now hidden in some pit, or in some other place. It will happen, when some of them have fallen at the first, that whoever hears it will say, ‘There is a slaughter among the people who follow Absalom!’

17.zh: 虽有人胆大如狮子，他的心也必消化；因为以色列人都知道你父亲是英雄，跟随他的人也都是勇士。
17.en: Even he who is valiant, whose heart is as the heart of a lion, will utterly melt; for all Israel knows that your father is a mighty man, and those who are with him are valiant men.

17.zh: 依我之计，不如将以色列众人—从但直到别是巴，如同海边的沙那样多—聚集到你这里来，你也亲自率领他们出战。
17.en: But I counsel that all Israel be gathered together to you, from Dan even to Beersheba, as the sand that is by the sea for multitude; and that you go to battle in your own person.

17.zh: 这样，我们在何处遇见他，就下到他那里，如同露水下在地上一般，连他带跟随他的人，一个也不留下。
17.en: So we will come on him in some place where he will be found, and we will light on him as the dew falls on the ground, then we will not leave so much as one of him and of all the men who are with him.

17.zh: 他若进了哪一座城，以色列众人必带绳子去，将那城拉到河里，甚至连一块小石头都不剩下。」
17.en: Moreover, if he has gone into a city, then all Israel will bring ropes to that city, and we will draw it into the river, until there isn’t one small stone found there.”

17.zh: 押沙龙和以色列众人说：「亚基人户筛的计谋比亚希多弗的计谋更好！」这是因耶和华定意破坏亚希多弗的良谋，为要降祸与押沙龙。
17.en: Absalom and all the men of Israel said, “The counsel of Hushai the Archite is better than the counsel of Ahithophel.” For the LORD had ordained to defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel, to the intent that the LORD might bring evil on Absalom.

17.zh: 户筛对祭司撒督和亚比亚他说： 「亚希多弗为押沙龙和以色列的长老所定的计谋是如此如此，我所定的计谋是如此如此。
17.en: Then Hushai said to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, “Ahithophel counseled Absalom and the elders of Israel that way; and I have counseled this way.

17.zh: 现在你们要急速打发人去，告诉大卫说：『今夜不可住在旷野的渡口，务要过河，免得王和跟随他的人都被吞灭。』」
17.en: Now therefore send quickly, and tell David, saying, ‘Don’t lodge tonight at the fords of the wilderness, but by all means pass over, lest the king be swallowed up, and all the people who are with him.’”

17.zh: 那时，约拿单和亚希玛斯在隐·罗结那里等候，不敢进城，恐怕被人看见。有一个使女出来，将这话告诉他们，他们就去报信给大卫王。
17.en: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz were staying by En Rogel; and a female servant used to go and report to them, and they went and told King David; for they couldn’t risk being seen coming into the city.

17.zh: 然而有一个童子看见他们，就去告诉押沙龙。他们急忙跑到巴户琳某人的家里；那人院中有一口井，他们就下到井里。
17.en: But a boy saw them, and told Absalom. Then they both went away quickly and came to the house of a man in Bahurim, who had a well in his court; and they went down there.

17.zh: 那家的妇人用盖盖上井口，又在上头铺上碎麦，事就没有泄漏。
17.en: The woman took and spread the covering over the well’s mouth, and spread out crushed grain on it; and nothing was known.

17.zh: 押沙龙的仆人来到那家，问妇人说：「亚希玛斯和约拿单在哪里？」妇人说：「他们过了河了。」仆人找他们，找不着，就回耶路撒冷去了。
17.en: Absalom’s servants came to the woman to the house; and they said, “Where are Ahimaaz and Jonathan?” The woman said to them, “They have gone over the brook of water.” When they had sought and could not find them, they returned to Jerusalem.

17.zh: 他们走后，二人从井里上来，去告诉大卫王说：「亚希多弗如此如此定计害你，你们务要起来，快快过河。」
17.en: After they had departed, they came up out of the well and went and told King David; and they said to David, “Arise and pass quickly over the water; for thus has Ahithophel counseled against you.”

17.zh: 于是大卫和跟随他的人都起来，过约旦河。到了天亮，无一人不过约旦河的。
17.en: Then David arose, and all the people who were with him, and they passed over the Jordan. By the morning light there lacked not one of them who had not gone over the Jordan.

17.zh: 亚希多弗见不依从他的计谋，就备上驴，归回本城；到了家，留下遗言，便吊死了，葬在他父亲的坟墓里。
17.en: When Ahithophel saw that his counsel was not followed, he saddled his donkey, arose, and went home to his city, set his house in order, and hanged himself; and he died, and was buried in the tomb of his father.

17.zh: 大卫到了玛哈念，押沙龙和跟随他的以色列人也都过了约旦河。
17.en: Then David came to Mahanaim. Absalom passed over the Jordan, he and all the men of Israel with him.

17.zh: 押沙龙立亚玛撒作元帅，代替约押。亚玛撒是[以实玛利]人以特拉的儿子。以特拉曾与拿辖的女儿亚比该亲近；这亚比该与约押的母亲洗鲁雅是姊妹。
17.en: Absalom set Amasa over the army instead of Joab. Now Amasa was the son of a man whose name was Ithra the Israelite, who went in to Abigail the daughter of Nahash, sister to Zeruiah, Joab’s mother.

17.zh: 押沙龙和以色列人都安营在基列地。
17.en: Israel and Absalom encamped in the land of Gilead.

17.zh: 大卫到了玛哈念，亚扪族的拉巴人拿辖的儿子朔比，罗·底巴人亚米利的儿子玛吉，基列的罗基琳人巴西莱，
17.en: When David had come to Mahanaim, Shobi the son of Nahash of Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and Machir the son of Ammiel of Lodebar, and Barzillai the Gileadite of Rogelim,

17.zh: 带着被、褥、盆、碗、瓦器、小麦、大麦、麦面、炒[谷]、豆子、红豆、炒[豆]、
17.en: brought beds, basins, earthen vessels, wheat, barley, meal, parched grain, beans, lentils, roasted grain,

17.zh: 蜂蜜、奶油、绵羊、奶饼，供给大卫和跟随他的人吃；他们说：「民在旷野，必饥渴困乏了。」
17.en: honey, butter, sheep, and cheese of the herd, for David and for the people who were with him to eat; for they said, “The people are hungry, weary, and thirsty in the wilderness.”

18.zh: 大卫数点跟随他的人，立千夫长、百夫长率领他们。
18.en: David counted the people who were with him, and set captains of thousands and captains of hundreds over them.

18.zh: 大卫打发军兵出战，分为三队：一队在约押手下，一队在洗鲁雅的儿子、约押兄弟亚比筛手下，一队在迦特人以太手下。大卫对军兵说：「我必与你们一同出战。」
18.en: David sent the people out, a third part under the hand of Joab, and a third part under the hand of Abishai the son of Zeruiah, Joab’s brother, and a third part under the hand of Ittai the Gittite. The king said to the people, “I will also surely go out with you myself.”

18.zh: 军兵却说：「你不可出战。若是我们逃跑，敌人必不介意；我们阵亡一半，敌人也不介意。因为你一人强似我们万人，你不如在城里预备帮助我们。」
18.en: But the people said, “You shall not go out, for if we flee away, they will not care for us, neither if half of us die, will they care for us. But you are worth ten thousand of us. Therefore now it is better that you are ready to help us out of the city.”

18.zh: 王向他们说：「你们以为怎样好，我就怎样行。」于是王站在城门旁，军兵或百或千地挨次出去了。
18.en: The king said to them, “I will do what seems best to you.” The king stood beside the gate, and all the people went out by hundreds and by thousands.

18.zh: 王嘱咐约押、亚比筛、以太说：「你们要为我的缘故宽待那少年人押沙龙。」王为押沙龙嘱咐众将的话，兵都听见了。
18.en: The king commanded Joab and Abishai and Ittai, saying, “Deal gently for my sake with the young man Absalom.” All the people heard when the king commanded all the captains concerning Absalom.

18.zh: 兵就出到田野迎着以色列人，在以法莲树林里交战。
18.en: So the people went out into the field against Israel; and the battle was in the forest of Ephraim.

18.zh: 以色列人败在大卫的仆人面前；那日阵亡的甚多，共有二万人。
18.en: The people of Israel were struck there before David’s servants, and there was a great slaughter there that day of twenty thousand men.

18.zh: 因为在那里四面打仗，死于树林的比死于刀剑的更多。
18.en: For the battle was there spread over the surface of all the country, and the forest devoured more people that day than the sword devoured.

18.zh: 押沙龙偶然遇见大卫的仆人。押沙龙骑着骡子，从大橡树密枝底下经过，他的头[发]被树枝绕住，就悬挂起来，所骑的骡子便离他去了。
18.en: Absalom happened to meet David’s servants. Absalom was riding on his mule, and the mule went under the thick boughs of a great oak; and his head caught hold of the oak, and he was hanging between the sky and earth; and the mule that was under him went on.

18.zh: 有个人看见，就告诉约押说：「我看见押沙龙挂在橡树上了。」
18.en: A certain man saw it, and told Joab, and said, “Behold, I saw Absalom hanging in an oak.”

18.zh: 约押对报信的人说：「你既看见他，为什么不将他打死落在地上呢？[你若打死他]，我就赏你十[舍客勒]银子，一条带子。」
18.en: Joab said to the man who told him, “Behold, you saw it, and why didn’t you strike him there to the ground? I would have given you ten pieces of silver and a sash.”

18.zh: 那人对约押说：「我就是得你一千[舍客勒]银子，我也不敢伸手害王的儿子；因为我们听见王嘱咐你和亚比筛并以太说：『你们要谨慎，不可害那少年人押沙龙。』
18.en: The man said to Joab, “Though I should receive a thousand pieces of silver in my hand, I still wouldn’t stretch out my hand against the king’s son; for in our hearing the king commanded you and Abishai and Ittai, saying, ‘Beware that no one touch the young man Absalom.’

18.zh: 我若妄为害了他的性命，就是你自己也必与我为敌（原来，无论何事都瞒不过王。）」
18.en: Otherwise, if I had dealt falsely against his life (and there is no matter hidden from the king), then you yourself would have set yourself against me.”

18.zh: 约押说：「我不能与你留连。」约押手拿三杆短枪，趁押沙龙在橡树上还活着，就刺透他的心。
18.en: Then Joab said, “I’m not going to wait like this with you.” He took three darts in his hand and thrust them through Absalom’s heart while he was still alive in the middle of the oak.

18.zh: 给约押拿兵器的十个少年人围绕押沙龙，将他杀死。
18.en: Ten young men who bore Joab’s armor surrounded and struck Absalom, and killed him.

18.zh: 约押吹角，拦阻众人，他们就回来，不再追赶以色列人。
18.en: Joab blew the trumpet, and the people returned from pursuing after Israel; for Joab held the people back.

18.zh: 他们将押沙龙丢在林中一个大坑里，上头堆起一大堆石头。以色列众人都逃跑，各回各家去了。
18.en: They took Absalom and cast him into a great pit in the forest, and raised over him a very great heap of stones. Then all Israel fled, each to his own tent.

18.zh: 押沙龙活着的时候，在王谷立了一根[石]柱，因他说：「我没有儿子为我留名。」他就以自己的名称那[石]柱叫押沙龙柱，直到今日。
18.en: Now Absalom in his lifetime had taken and reared up for himself the pillar which is in the king’s valley, for he said, “I have no son to keep my name in memory.” He called the pillar after his own name. It is called Absalom’s monument, to this day.

18.zh: 撒督的儿子亚希玛斯说：「容我跑去，将耶和华向仇敌给王报仇的信息报与王知。」
18.en: Then Ahimaaz the son of Zadok said, “Let me now run and carry the king news, how the LORD has avenged him of his enemies.”

18.zh: 约押对他说：「你今日不可去报信，改日可以报信；因为今日王的儿子死了，所以你不可去报信。」
18.en: Joab said to him, “You must not be the bearer of news today, but you must carry news another day. But today you must carry no news, because the king’s son is dead.”

18.zh: 约押对古示人说：「你去将你所看见的告诉王。」古示人在约押面前下拜，就跑去了。
18.en: Then Joab said to the Cushite, “Go, tell the king what you have seen!” The Cushite bowed himself to Joab, and ran.

18.zh: 撒督的儿子亚希玛斯又对约押说：「无论怎样，求你容我随着古示人跑去。」约押说：「我儿，你报这信息，既不得赏赐，何必要跑去呢？」
18.en: Then Ahimaaz the son of Zadok said yet again to Joab, “But come what may, please let me also run after the Cushite.” Joab said, “Why do you want to run, my son, since you will have no reward for the news?”

18.zh: 他[又说]：「无论怎样，我要跑去。」约押说：「你跑去吧！」亚希玛斯就从平原往前跑，跑过古示人去了。
18.en: “But come what may,” he said, “I will run.” He said to him, “Run!” Then Ahimaaz ran by the way of the Plain, and outran the Cushite.

18.zh: 大卫正坐在城瓮里。守望的人上城门楼的顶上，举目观看，见有一个人独自跑来。
18.en: Now David was sitting between the two gates; and the watchman went up to the roof of the gate to the wall, and lifted up his eyes and looked, and, behold, a man running alone.

18.zh: 守望的人就大声告诉王。王说：「他若独自来，必是报口信的。」那人跑得渐渐近了。
18.en: The watchman shouted and told the king. The king said, “If he is alone, there is news in his mouth.” He came closer and closer.

18.zh: 守望的人又见一人跑来，就对守城门的人说：「又有一人独自跑来。」王说：「这也必是报信的。」
18.en: The watchman saw another man running; and the watchman called to the gatekeeper and said, “Behold, a man running alone!” The king said, “He also brings news.”

18.zh: 守望的人说：「我看前头人的跑法，好像撒督的儿子亚希玛斯的跑法一样。」王说：「他是个好人，必是报好信息。」
18.en: The watchman said, “I think the running of the first one is like the running of Ahimaaz the son of Zadok.” The king said, “He is a good man, and comes with good news.”

18.zh: 亚希玛斯向王呼叫说：「平安了！」就在王面前脸伏于地叩拜，说：「耶和华—你的　神是应当称颂的，因他已将那举手攻击我主我王的人交给王了。」
18.en: Ahimaaz called, and said to the king, “All is well.” He bowed himself before the king with his face to the earth, and said, “Blessed is the LORD your God, who has delivered up the men who lifted up their hand against my lord the king!”

18.zh: 王问说：「少年人押沙龙平安不平安？」亚希玛斯回答说：「约押打发王的仆人，那时仆人听见众民大声喧哗，却不知道是什么事。」
18.en: The king said, “Is it well with the young man Absalom?” Ahimaaz answered, “When Joab sent the king’s servant, even me your servant, I saw a great tumult, but I don’t know what it was.”

18.zh: 王说：「你退去，站在旁边。」他就退去，站在旁边。
18.en: The king said, “Come and stand here.” He came and stood still.

18.zh: 古示人也来到，说：「有信息报给我主我王！耶和华今日向一切兴起攻击你的人给你报仇了。」
18.en: Behold, the Cushite came. The Cushite said, “Good news for my lord the king, for the LORD has avenged you today of all those who rose up against you.”

18.zh: 王问古示人说：「少年人押沙龙平安不平安？」古示人回答说：「愿我主我王的仇敌，和一切兴起要杀害你的人，都与那少年人一样。」
18.en: The king said to the Cushite, “Is it well with the young man Absalom?” The Cushite answered, “May the enemies of my lord the king, and all who rise up against you to do you harm, be as that young man is.”

18.zh: 王就心里伤恸，上城门楼去哀哭，一面走一面说：「我儿押沙龙啊！我儿，我儿押沙龙啊！我恨不得替你死，押沙龙啊，我儿！我儿！」
18.en: The king was much moved, and went up to the room over the gate and wept. As he went, he said, “My son Absalom! My son, my son Absalom! I wish I had died instead of you, Absalom, my son, my son!”

19.zh: 有人告诉约押说：「王为押沙龙哭泣悲哀。」
19.en: Joab was told, “Behold, the king weeps and mourns for Absalom.”

19.zh: 众民听说王为他儿子忧愁，他们得胜的欢乐却变成悲哀。
19.en: The victory that day was turned into mourning among all the people, for the people heard it said that day, “The king grieves for his son.”

19.zh: 那日众民暗暗地进城，就如败阵逃跑、惭愧的民一般。
19.en: The people sneaked into the city that day, as people who are ashamed steal away when they flee in battle.

19.zh: 王蒙着脸，大声哭号说：「我儿押沙龙啊！押沙龙，我儿，我儿啊！」
19.en: The king covered his face, and the king cried with a loud voice, “My son Absalom, Absalom, my son, my son!”

19.zh: 约押进去见王，说：「你今日使你一切仆人脸面惭愧了！他们今日救了你的性命和你儿女妻妾的性命，
19.en: Joab came into the house to the king, and said, “Today you have shamed the faces of all your servants who today have saved your life, and the lives of your sons and of your daughters, and the lives of your wives, and the lives of your concubines;

19.zh: 你却爱那恨你的人，恨那爱你的人。你今日明明地不以将帅、仆人为念。我今日看明，若押沙龙活着，我们都死亡，你就喜悦了。
19.en: in that you love those who hate you and hate those who love you. For you have declared today that princes and servants are nothing to you. For today I perceive that if Absalom had lived and we had all died today, then it would have pleased you well.

19.zh: 现在你当出去，安慰你仆人的心。我指着耶和华起誓：你若不出去，今夜必无一人与你同在一处；这祸患就比你从幼年到如今所遭的更甚！」
19.en: Now therefore arise, go out and speak to comfort your servants; for I swear by the LORD, if you don’t go out, not a man will stay with you this night. That would be worse to you than all the evil that has happened to you from your youth until now.”

19.zh: 于是王起来，坐在城门口。众民听说王坐在城门口，就都到王面前。 以色列人已经逃跑，各回各家去了。
19.en: Then the king arose and sat in the gate. The people were all told, “Behold, the king is sitting in the gate.” All the people came before the king. Now Israel had fled every man to his tent.

19.zh: 以色列众支派的人纷纷议论说：「王曾救我们脱离仇敌的手，又救我们脱离非利士人的手，现在他躲避押沙龙逃走了。
19.en: All the people were at strife throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, “The king delivered us out of the hand of our enemies, and he saved us out of the hand of the Philistines; and now he has fled out of the land from Absalom.

19.zh: 我们膏押沙龙治理我们，他已经阵亡。现在为什么不出一言请王回来呢？」
19.en: Absalom, whom we anointed over us, is dead in battle. Now therefore why don’t you speak a word of bringing the king back?”

19.zh: 大卫王差人去见祭司撒督和亚比亚他，说：「你们当向犹大长老说：『以色列众人已经有话请王回宫，你们为什么落在他们后头呢？
19.en: King David sent to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, saying, “Speak to the elders of Judah, saying, ‘Why are you the last to bring the king back to his house, since the speech of all Israel has come to the king, to return him to his house?

19.zh: 你们是我的弟兄，是我的骨肉，为什么在人后头请王回来呢？』
19.en: You are my brothers. You are my bone and my flesh. Why then are you the last to bring back the king?’

19.zh: 也要对亚玛撒说：『你不是我的骨肉吗？我若不立你替约押常作元帅，愿　神重重地降罚与我！』」
19.en: Say to Amasa, ‘Aren’t you my bone and my flesh? God do so to me, and more also, if you aren’t captain of the army before me continually instead of Joab.’”

19.zh: 如此就挽回犹大众人的心，如同一人的心。他们便打发人去见王，说：「请王和王的一切臣仆回来。」
19.en: He bowed the heart of all the men of Judah, even as one man, so that they sent to the king, saying, “Return, you and all your servants.”

19.zh: 王就回来，到了约旦河。犹大人来到吉甲，要去迎接王，请他过约旦河。
19.en: So the king returned, and came to the Jordan. Judah came to Gilgal, to go to meet the king, to bring the king over the Jordan.

19.zh: 巴户琳的便雅悯人、基拉的儿子示每急忙与犹大人一同下去迎接大卫王。
19.en: Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjamite, who was of Bahurim, hurried and came down with the men of Judah to meet King David.

19.zh: 跟从示每的有一千便雅悯人，还有扫罗家的仆人洗巴和他十五个儿子，二十个仆人；他们都趟过约旦河迎接王。
19.en: There were a thousand men of Benjamin with him, and Ziba the servant of Saul’s house, and his fifteen sons and his twenty servants with him; and they went through the Jordan in the presence of the king.

19.zh: 有摆渡船过去，渡王的家眷，任王使用。 王要过约旦河的时候，基拉的儿子示每就俯伏在王面前，
19.en: A ferry boat went to bring over the king’s household, and to do what he thought good. Shimei the son of Gera fell down before the king when he had come over the Jordan.

19.zh: 对王说：「我主我王出耶路撒冷的时候，仆人行悖逆的事，现在求我主不要因此加罪与仆人，不要记念，也不要放在心上。
19.en: He said to the king, “Don’t let my lord impute iniquity to me, or remember that which your servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Jerusalem, that the king should take it to his heart.

19.zh: 仆人明知自己有罪，所以约瑟全家之中，今日我首先下来迎接我主我王。」
19.en: For your servant knows that I have sinned. Therefore behold, I have come today as the first of all the house of Joseph to go down to meet my lord the king.”

19.zh: 洗鲁雅的儿子亚比筛说：「示每既咒骂耶和华的受膏者，不应当治死他吗？」
19.en: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered, “Shouldn’t Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed the LORD’s anointed?”

19.zh: 大卫说：「洗鲁雅的儿子，我与你们有何关涉，使你们今日与我反对呢？今日在以色列中岂可治死人呢？我岂不知今日我作以色列的王吗？」
19.en: David said, “What have I to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah, that you should be adversaries to me today? Shall any man be put to death today in Israel? For don’t I know that I am king over Israel today?”

19.zh: 于是王对示每说：「你必不死。」王就向他起誓。
19.en: The king said to Shimei, “You will not die.” The king swore to him.

19.zh: 扫罗的孙子米非波设也下去迎接王。他自从王去的日子，直到王平平安安地回来，没有修脚，没有剃胡须，也没有洗衣服。
19.en: Mephibosheth the son of Saul came down to meet the king; and he had neither groomed his feet, nor trimmed his beard, nor washed his clothes, from the day the king departed until the day he came home in peace.

19.zh: 他来到耶路撒冷迎接王的时候，王问他说：「米非波设，你为什么没有与我同去呢？」
19.en: When he had come to Jerusalem to meet the king, the king said to him, “Why didn’t you go with me, Mephibosheth?”

19.zh: 他回答说：「我主我王，仆人是瘸腿的。那日我想要备驴骑上，与王同去，无奈我的仆人欺哄了我，
19.en: He answered, “My lord, O king, my servant deceived me. For your servant said, ‘I will saddle a donkey for myself, that I may ride on it and go with the king,’ because your servant is lame.

19.zh: 又在我主我王面前谗毁我。然而我主我王如同　神的使者一般，你看怎样好，就怎样行吧！
19.en: He has slandered your servant to my lord the king, but my lord the king is as an angel of God. Therefore do what is good in your eyes.

19.zh: 因为我祖全家的人，在我主我王面前都算为死人，王却使仆人在王的席上同人吃饭，我现在向王还能辨理诉冤吗？」
19.en: For all my father’s house were but dead men before my lord the king; yet you set your servant among those who ate at your own table. What right therefore have I yet that I should appeal any more to the king?”

19.zh: 王对他说：「你何必再提你的事呢？我说，你与洗巴均分地土。」
19.en: The king said to him, “Why do you speak any more of your matters? I say, you and Ziba divide the land.”

19.zh: 米非波设对王说：「我主我王既平平安安地回宫，就任凭洗巴都取了也可以。」
19.en: Mephibosheth said to the king, “Yes, let him take all, because my lord the king has come in peace to his own house.”

19.zh: 基列人巴西莱从罗基琳下来，要送王过约旦河，就与王一同过了约旦河。
19.en: Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim; and he went over the Jordan with the king to conduct him over the Jordan.

19.zh: 巴西莱年纪老迈，已经八十岁了。王住在玛哈念的时候，他就拿食物来供给王；他原是大富户。
19.en: Now Barzillai was a very aged man, even eighty years old. He had provided the king with sustenance while he stayed at Mahanaim, for he was a very great man.

19.zh: 王对巴西莱说：「你与我同去，我要在耶路撒冷那里养你的老。」
19.en: The king said to Barzillai, “Come over with me, and I will sustain you with me in Jerusalem.”

19.zh: 巴西莱对王说：「我在世的年日还能有多少，使我与王同上耶路撒冷呢？
19.en: Barzillai said to the king, “How many are the days of the years of my life, that I should go up with the king to Jerusalem?

19.zh: 仆人现在八十岁了，还能尝出饮食的滋味、辨别美恶吗？还能听男女歌唱的声音吗？仆人何必累赘我主我王呢？
19.en: I am eighty years old, today. Can I discern between good and bad? Can your servant taste what I eat or what I drink? Can I hear the voice of singing men and singing women any more? Why then should your servant be a burden to my lord the king?

19.zh: 仆人只要送王过约旦河，王何必赐我这样的恩典呢？
19.en: Your servant will just go over the Jordan with the king. Why should the king repay me with such a reward?

19.zh: 求你准我回去，好死在我本城，[葬在]我父母的墓旁。这里有王的仆人金罕，让他同我主我王过去，可以随意待他。」
19.en: Please let your servant turn back again, that I may die in my own city, by the grave of my father and my mother. But behold, your servant Chimham; let him go over with my lord the king; and do to him what shall seem good to you.”

19.zh: 王说：「金罕可以与我同去，我必照你的心愿待他。你向我求什么，我都必为你成就。」
19.en: The king answered, “Chimham shall go over with me, and I will do to him that which shall seem good to you. Whatever you request of me, that I will do for you.”

19.zh: 于是众民过约旦河，王也过去。王与巴西莱亲嘴，为他祝福，巴西莱就回本地去了。
19.en: All the people went over the Jordan, and the king went over. Then the king kissed Barzillai and blessed him; and he returned to his own place.

19.zh: 王过去，到了吉甲，金罕也跟他过去。犹大众民和以色列民的一半也都送王过去。
19.en: So the king went over to Gilgal, and Chimham went over with him. All the people of Judah brought the king over, and also half the people of Israel.

19.zh: 以色列众人来见王，对他说：「我们弟兄犹大人为什么暗暗送王和王的家眷，并跟随王的人过约旦河？」
19.en: Behold, all the men of Israel came to the king, and said to the king, “Why have our brothers the men of Judah stolen you away, and brought the king and his household, over the Jordan, and all David’s men with him?”

19.zh: 犹大众人回答以色列人说：「因为王与我们是亲属，你们为何因这事发怒呢？我们吃了王的什么呢？王赏赐了我们什么呢？」
19.en: All the men of Judah answered the men of Israel, “Because the king is a close relative to us. Why then are you angry about this matter? Have we eaten at all at the king’s cost? Or has he given us any gift?”

19.zh: 以色列人回答犹大人说：「按支派，我们与王有十分的情分；在大卫身上，我们也比你们更有情分。你们为何藐视我们，请王回来不先与我们商量呢？」 但犹大人的话比以色列人的话更硬。
19.en: The men of Israel answered the men of Judah, and said, “We have ten parts in the king, and we have also more claim to David than you. Why then did you despise us, that our advice should not be first had in bringing back our king?” The words of the men of Judah were fiercer than the words of the men of Israel.

20.zh: 在那里恰巧有一个匪徒，名叫示巴，是便雅悯人比基利的儿子。他吹角，说：「我们与大卫无分，与耶西的儿子无涉。以色列人哪，你们各回各家去吧！」
20.en: There happened to be there a wicked fellow, whose name was Sheba the son of Bichri, a Benjamite; and he blew the trumpet, and said, “We have no portion in David, neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse. Every man to his tents, Israel!”

20.zh: 于是以色列人都离开大卫，跟随比基利的儿子示巴。但犹大人从约旦河直到耶路撒冷，都紧紧跟随他们的王。
20.en: So all the men of Israel went up from following David, and followed Sheba the son of Bichri; but the men of Judah joined with their king, from the Jordan even to Jerusalem.

20.zh: 大卫王来到耶路撒冷，进了宫殿，就把从前留下看守宫殿的十个妃嫔禁闭在[冷宫]，养活她们，不与她们亲近。她们如同寡妇被禁，直到死的日子。
20.en: David came to his house at Jerusalem; and the king took the ten women his concubines, whom he had left to keep the house, and put them in custody and provided them with sustenance, but didn’t go in to them. So they were shut up to the day of their death, living in widowhood.

20.zh: 王对亚玛撒说：「你要在三日之内将犹大人招聚了来，你也回到这里来。」
20.en: Then the king said to Amasa, “Call me the men of Judah together within three days, and be here present.”

20.zh: 亚玛撒就去招聚犹大人，却耽延过了王所限的日期。
20.en: So Amasa went to call the men of Judah together, but he stayed longer than the set time which had been appointed to him.

20.zh: 大卫对亚比筛说：「现在恐怕比基利的儿子示巴加害于我们比押沙龙更甚。你要带领你主的仆人追赶他，免得他得了坚固城，躲避我们。」
20.en: David said to Abishai, “Now Sheba the son of Bichri will do us more harm than Absalom did. Take your lord’s servants and pursue after him, lest he get himself fortified cities, and escape out of our sight.”

20.zh: 约押的人和基利提人、比利提人，并所有的勇士，都跟着亚比筛，从耶路撒冷出去追赶比基利的儿子示巴。
20.en: Joab’s men went out after him with the Cherethites, the Pelethites, and all the mighty men; and they went out of Jerusalem to pursue Sheba the son of Bichri.

20.zh: 他们到了基遍的大磐石那里，亚玛撒来迎接他们。那时约押穿着战衣，腰束佩刀的带子，刀在鞘内；约押前行，刀从鞘内掉出来。
20.en: When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa came to meet them. Joab was clothed in his apparel of war that he had put on, and on it was a sash with a sword fastened on his waist in its sheath; and as he went along it fell out.

20.zh: 约押[左手拾起刀来]，对亚玛撒说：「我兄弟，你好啊！」就用右手抓住亚玛撒的胡子，要与他亲嘴。
20.en: Joab said to Amasa, “Is it well with you, my brother?” Joab took Amasa by the beard with his right hand to kiss him.

20.zh: 亚玛撒没有防备约押手里所拿的刀；约押用刀刺入他的肚腹，他的肠子流在地上，没有再刺他，就死了。 约押和他兄弟亚比筛往前追赶比基利的儿子示巴。
20.en: But Amasa took no heed to the sword that was in Joab’s hand. So he struck him with it in the body and shed out his bowels to the ground, and didn’t strike him again; and he died. Joab and Abishai his brother pursued Sheba the son of Bichri.

20.zh: 有约押的一个少年人站在亚玛撒尸身旁边，[对众人]说：「谁喜悦约押，谁归顺大卫，就当跟随约押去。」
20.en: One of Joab’s young men stood by him, and said, “He who favors Joab, and he who is for David, let him follow Joab!”

20.zh: 亚玛撒在道路上滚在自己的血里。那人见众民[经过]都站住，就把亚玛撒的尸身从路上挪到田间，用衣服遮盖。
20.en: Amasa lay wallowing in his blood in the middle of the highway. When the man saw that all the people stood still, he carried Amasa out of the highway into the field, and cast a garment over him when he saw that everyone who came by him stood still.

20.zh: 尸身从路上挪移之后，众民就都跟随约押去追赶比基利的儿子示巴。
20.en: When he was removed out of the highway, all the people went on after Joab to pursue Sheba the son of Bichri.

20.zh: 他走遍以色列各支派，直到伯·玛迦的亚比拉，并比利人的全地；那些地方的人也都聚集跟随他。
20.en: He went through all the tribes of Israel to Abel, to Beth Maacah, and all the Berites. They were gathered together, and went also after him.

20.zh: 约押和跟随的人到了伯·玛迦的亚比拉，围困示巴，就对着城筑垒；跟随约押的众民[用锤]撞城，要使城塌陷。
20.en: They came and besieged him in Abel of Beth Maacah, and they cast up a mound against the city, and it stood against the rampart; and all the people who were with Joab battered the wall to throw it down.

20.zh: 有一个聪明妇人从城上呼叫说：「听啊，听啊，请约押近前来，我好与他说话。」
20.en: Then a wise woman cried out of the city, “Hear, hear! Please say to Joab, ‘Come near here, that I may speak with you.’”

20.zh: 约押就近前来，妇人问他说：「你是约押不是？」他说：「我是。」妇人说：「求你听婢女的话。」约押说：「我听。」
20.en: He came near to her; and the woman said, “Are you Joab?” He answered, “I am.” Then she said to him, “Hear the words of your servant.” He answered, “I’m listening.”

20.zh: 妇人说：「古时有话说，当先在亚比拉求问，然后事就定妥。
20.en: Then she spoke, saying, “They used to say in old times, ‘They shall surely ask counsel at Abel,’ and so they settled a matter.

20.zh: 我们这城的人在以色列人中是和平、忠厚的。你为何要毁坏以色列中的大城，吞灭耶和华的产业呢？」
20.en: I am among those who are peaceable and faithful in Israel. You seek to destroy a city and a mother in Israel. Why will you swallow up the LORD’s inheritance?”

20.zh: 约押回答说：「我决不吞灭毁坏，
20.en: Joab answered, “Far be it, far be it from me, that I should swallow up or destroy.

20.zh: 乃因以法莲山地的一个人—比基利的儿子示巴—举手攻击大卫王，你们若将他一人交出来，我便离城而去。」妇人对约押说：「那人的首级必从城墙上丢给你。」
20.en: The matter is not so. But a man of the hill country of Ephraim, Sheba the son of Bichri by name, has lifted up his hand against the king, even against David. Just deliver him, and I will depart from the city.” The woman said to Joab, “Behold, his head will be thrown to you over the wall.”

20.zh: 妇人就凭她的智慧去劝众人。他们便割下比基利的儿子示巴的首级，丢给约押。约押吹角，众人就离城而散，各归各家去了。约押回耶路撒冷，到王那里。
20.en: Then the woman went to all the people in her wisdom. They cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri, and threw it out to Joab. He blew the trumpet, and they were dispersed from the city, every man to his tent. Then Joab returned to Jerusalem to the king.

20.zh: 约押作以色列全军的元帅；耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅统辖基利提人和比利提人；
20.en: Now Joab was over all the army of Israel, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites,

20.zh: 亚多兰掌管服苦的人；亚希律的儿子约沙法作史官；
20.en: Adoram was over the men subject to forced labor, Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was the recorder,

20.zh: 示法作书记；撒督和亚比亚他作祭司[长]；
20.en: Sheva was scribe, Zadok and Abiathar were priests,

20.zh: 睚珥人以拉作大卫的宰相。
20.en: and Ira the Jairite was chief minister to David.

21.zh: 大卫年间有饥荒，一连三年，大卫就求问耶和华。耶和华说：「这饥荒是因扫罗和他流人血之家杀死基遍人。」
21.en: There was a famine in the days of David for three years, year after year; and David sought the face of the LORD. The LORD said, “It is for Saul, and for his bloody house, because he put the Gibeonites to death.”

21.zh: 原来这基遍人不是以色列人，乃是亚摩利人中所剩的；以色列人曾向他们起誓，[不杀灭他们]，扫罗却为以色列人和犹大人发热心，想要杀灭他们。大卫王召了他们来，
21.en: The king called the Gibeonites and said to them (now the Gibeonites were not of the children of Israel, but of the remnant of the Amorites, and the children of Israel had sworn to them; and Saul sought to kill them in his zeal for the children of Israel and Judah);

21.zh: 问他们说：「我当为你们怎样行呢？可用什么赎这罪，使你们为耶和华的产业祝福呢？」
21.en: and David said to the Gibeonites, “What should I do for you? And with what should I make atonement, that you may bless the LORD’s inheritance?”

21.zh: 基遍人回答说：「我们和扫罗与他家的事并不关乎金银，也不要因我们的缘故杀一个以色列人。」大卫说：「你们怎样说，我就为你们怎样行。」
21.en: The Gibeonites said to him, “It is no matter of silver or gold between us and Saul or his house; neither is it for us to put any man to death in Israel.” He said, “I will do for you whatever you say.”

21.zh: 他们对王说：「那从前谋害我们、要灭我们、使我们不得再住以色列境内的人，
21.en: They said to the king, “The man who consumed us and who plotted against us, that we should be destroyed from remaining in any of the borders of Israel,

21.zh: 现在愿将他的子孙七人交给我们，我们好在耶和华面前，将他们悬挂在耶和华拣选扫罗的基比亚。」王说：「我必交给你们。」
21.en: let seven men of his sons be delivered to us, and we will hang them up to the LORD in Gibeah of Saul, the chosen of the LORD.” The king said, “I will give them.”

21.zh: 王因为曾与扫罗的儿子约拿单指着耶和华起誓[结盟]，就爱惜扫罗的孙子、约拿单的儿子米非波设，[不交出来]，
21.en: But the king spared Mephibosheth the son of Jonathan the son of Saul, because of the LORD’s oath that was between them, between David and Jonathan the son of Saul.

21.zh: 却把爱雅的女儿利斯巴给扫罗所生的两个儿子亚摩尼、米非波设，和扫罗女儿米甲[的姊姊]给米何拉人巴西莱儿子亚得列所生的五个儿子
21.en: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bore to Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Merab the daughter of Saul, whom she bore to Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite.

21.zh: 交在基遍人的手里。基遍人就把他们，在耶和华面前，悬挂在山上，这七人就一同死亡。被杀的时候正是收割的日子，就是动手割大麦的时候。
21.en: He delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites; and they hanged them on the mountain before the LORD, and all seven of them fell together. They were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first days, at the beginning of barley harvest.

21.zh: 爱雅的女儿利斯巴用麻布在磐石上搭棚，从动手收割的时候直到天降雨在尸身上的时候，日间不容空中的雀鸟落在尸身上，夜间不让田野的走兽前来糟践。
21.en: Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth and spread it for herself on the rock, from the beginning of harvest until water poured on them from the sky. She allowed neither the birds of the sky to rest on them by day, nor the animals of the field by night.

21.zh: 有人将扫罗的妃嫔爱雅女儿利斯巴所行的这事告诉大卫。
21.en: David was told what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Saul, had done.

21.zh: 大卫就去，从基列·雅比人那里将扫罗和他儿子约拿单的骸骨搬了来（是因非利士人从前在基利波杀扫罗，将尸身悬挂在伯·珊的街市上，基列·雅比人把尸身偷了去。）
21.en: So David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabesh Gilead, who had stolen them from the street of Beth Shan, where the Philistines had hanged them in the day that the Philistines killed Saul in Gilboa;

21.zh: 大卫将扫罗和他儿子约拿单的骸骨从那里搬了来，又收殓被悬挂七人的骸骨，
21.en: and he brought up from there the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son. They also gathered the bones of those who were hanged.

21.zh: 将扫罗和他儿子约拿单的骸骨葬在便雅悯的洗拉，在扫罗父亲基士的坟墓里；众人行了王所吩咐的。此后　神垂听国民所求的。
21.en: They buried the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son in the country of Benjamin in Zela, in the tomb of Kish his father; and they performed all that the king commanded. After that, God answered prayer for the land.

21.zh: 非利士人与以色列人打仗；大卫带领仆人下去，与非利士人接战，大卫就疲乏了。
21.en: The Philistines had war again with Israel; and David went down, and his servants with him, and fought against the Philistines. David grew faint;

21.zh: 伟人的一个儿子以实·比诺要杀大卫；他的铜枪重三百[舍客勒]，又佩着新[刀]。
21.en: and Ishbibenob, who was of the sons of the giant, the weight of whose spear was three hundred shekels of bronze in weight, he being armed with a new sword, thought he would kill David.

21.zh: 但洗鲁雅的儿子亚比筛帮助大卫，攻打非利士人，将他杀死。当日，跟随大卫的人向大卫起誓说：「以后你不可再与我们一同出战，恐怕熄灭以色列的灯。」
21.en: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah helped him, and struck the Philistine and killed him. Then the men of David swore to him, saying, “Don’t go out with us to battle any more, so that you don’t quench the lamp of Israel.”

21.zh: 后来，以色列人在歌伯与非利士人打仗，户沙人西比该杀了伟人的一个儿子撒弗。
21.en: After this, there was again war with the Philistines at Gob. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Saph, who was of the sons of the giant.

21.zh: 又在歌伯与非利士人打仗，伯利恒人雅雷俄珥金的儿子伊勒哈难杀了迦特人歌利亚。这人的枪杆粗如织布的机轴。
21.en: There was again war with the Philistines at Gob, and Elhanan the son of Jaare-Oregim the Bethlehemite killed Goliath the Gittite’s brother, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.

21.zh: 又在迦特打仗，那里有一个身量高大的人，手脚都是六指，共有二十四个指头；他也是伟人的儿子。
21.en: There was again war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, who had six fingers on every hand and six toes on every foot, twenty-four in number, and he also was born to the giant.

21.zh: 这人向以色列人骂阵，大卫的哥哥示米亚的儿子约拿单就杀了他。
21.en: When he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimei, David’s brother, killed him.

21.zh: 这四个人是迦特伟人的儿子，都死在大卫和他仆人的手下。
21.en: These four were born to the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.

22.zh: 当耶和华救大卫脱离一切仇敌和扫罗之手的日子，他向耶和华念这诗，
22.en: David spoke to the LORD the words of this song in the day that the LORD delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul,

22.zh: 说： 耶和华是我的岩石， 我的山寨，我的救主，
22.en: and he said: “The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer, even mine;

22.zh: 我的　神，我的磐石，我所投靠的。 他是我的盾牌，是拯救我的角， 是我的高台，是我的避难所。 我的救主啊，你是救我脱离强暴的。
22.en: God is my rock in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge. My savior, you save me from violence.

22.zh: 我要求告当赞美的耶和华， 这样，我必从仇敌手中被救出来。
22.en: I call on the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; So shall I be saved from my enemies.

22.zh: 曾有死亡的波浪环绕我， 匪类的急流使我惊惧，
22.en: For the waves of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.

22.zh: 阴间的绳索缠绕我， 死亡的网罗临到我。
22.en: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death caught me.

22.zh: 我在急难中求告耶和华， 向我的　神呼求。 他从殿中听了我的声音； 我的呼求入了他的耳中。
22.en: In my distress, I called on the LORD. Yes, I called to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry came into his ears.

22.zh: 那时因他发怒，地就摇撼战抖； 天的根基也震动摇撼。
22.en: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations of heaven quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.

22.zh: 从他鼻孔冒烟上腾； 从他口中发火焚烧，连炭也着了。
22.en: Smoke went up out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.

22.zh: 他又使天下垂，亲自降临； 有黑云在他脚下。
22.en: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet.

22.zh: 他坐着基路伯飞行， 在风的翅膀上显现。
22.en: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he was seen on the wings of the wind.

22.zh: 他以黑暗和聚集的水、 天空的厚云为他四围的行宫。
22.en: He made darkness a shelter around himself, gathering of waters, and thick clouds of the skies.

22.zh: 因他面前的光辉炭都着了。
22.en: At the brightness before him, coals of fire were kindled.

22.zh: 耶和华从天上打雷； 至高者发出声音。
22.en: The LORD thundered from heaven. The Most High uttered his voice.

22.zh: 他射出箭来，使仇敌四散， 发出闪电，使他们扰乱。
22.en: He sent out arrows and scattered them, lightning and confused them.

22.zh: 耶和华的斥责一发，鼻孔的气一出， 海底就出现，大地的根基也显露。
22.en: Then the channels of the sea appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare by the LORD’s rebuke, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.

22.zh: 他从高天伸手抓住我， 把我从大水中拉上来。
22.en: He sent from on high and he took me. He drew me out of many waters.

22.zh: 他救我脱离我的劲敌和那些恨我的人， 因为他们比我强盛。
22.en: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me, for they were too mighty for me.

22.zh: 我遭遇灾难的日子，他们来攻击我； 但耶和华是我的倚靠。
22.en: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but the LORD was my support.

22.zh: 他又领我到宽阔之处； 他救拔我，因他喜悦我。
22.en: He also brought me out into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.

22.zh: 耶和华按着我的公义报答我， 按着我手中的清洁赏赐我。
22.en: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness. He rewarded me according to the cleanness of my hands.

22.zh: 因为我遵守了耶和华的道， 未曾作恶离开我的　神。
22.en: For I have kept the LORD’s ways, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

22.zh: 他的一切典章常在我面前； 他的律例，我也未曾离弃。
22.en: For all his ordinances were before me. As for his statutes, I didn’t depart from them.

22.zh: 我在他面前作了完全人； 我也保守自己远离我的罪孽。
22.en: I was also perfect toward him. I kept myself from my iniquity.

22.zh: 所以耶和华按我的公义， 按我在他眼前的清洁赏赐我。
22.en: Therefore the LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness, According to my cleanness in his eyesight.

22.zh: 慈爱的人，你以慈爱待他； 完全的人，你以完全待他；
22.en: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man you will show yourself perfect.

22.zh: 清洁的人，你以清洁待他； 乖僻的人，你以弯曲待他。
22.en: With the pure you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.

22.zh: 困苦的百姓，你必拯救； 但你的眼目察看高傲的人，使他降卑。
22.en: You will save the afflicted people, but your eyes are on the arrogant, that you may bring them down.

22.zh: 耶和华啊，你是我的灯； 耶和华必照明我的黑暗。
22.en: For you are my lamp, LORD. The LORD will light up my darkness.

22.zh: 我借着你冲入敌军， 借着我的　神跳过墙垣。
22.en: For by you, I run against a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.

22.zh: 至于　神，他的道是完全的； 耶和华的话是炼净的。 凡投靠他的，他便作他们的盾牌。
22.en: As for God, his way is perfect. The LORD’s word is tested. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.

22.zh: 除了耶和华，谁是　神呢？ 除了我们的　神，谁是磐石呢？
22.en: For who is God, besides the LORD? Who is a rock, besides our God?

22.zh: 神是我坚固的保障； 他引导完全人行他的路。
22.en: God is my strong fortress. He makes my way perfect.

22.zh: 他使我的脚快如母鹿的[蹄]， 又使我在高处安稳。
22.en: He makes his feet like hinds’ feet, and sets me on my high places.

22.zh: 他教导我的手能以争战， 甚至我的膀臂能开铜弓。
22.en: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.

22.zh: 你把你的救恩给我作盾牌； 你的温和使我为大。
22.en: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your gentleness has made me great.

22.zh: 你使我脚下的地步宽阔； 我的脚未曾滑跌。
22.en: You have enlarged my steps under me. My feet have not slipped.

22.zh: 我追赶我的仇敌，灭绝了他们， 未灭以先，我没有归回。
22.en: I have pursued my enemies and destroyed them. I didn’t turn again until they were consumed.

22.zh: 我灭绝了他们， 打伤了他们，使他们不能起来； 他们都倒在我的脚下。
22.en: I have consumed them, and struck them through, so that they can’t arise. Yes, they have fallen under my feet.

22.zh: 因为你曾以力量束我的腰，使我能争战； 你也使那起来攻击我的都服在我以下。
22.en: For you have armed me with strength for the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.

22.zh: 你又使我的仇敌在我面前转背逃跑， 叫我能以剪除那恨我的人。
22.en: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.

22.zh: 他们仰望，却无人拯救； 就是呼求耶和华，他也不应允。
22.en: They looked, but there was no one to save; even to the LORD, but he didn’t answer them.

22.zh: 我捣碎他们，如同地上的灰尘， 践踏他们，四散在地，如同街上的泥土。
22.en: Then I beat them as small as the dust of the earth. I crushed them as the mire of the streets, and spread them abroad.

22.zh: 你救我脱离我百姓的争竞， 保护我作列国的元首； 我素不认识的民必事奉我。
22.en: You also have delivered me from the strivings of my people. You have kept me to be the head of the nations. A people whom I have not known will serve me.

22.zh: 外邦人要投降我， 一听见我的名声就必顺从我。
22.en: The foreigners will submit themselves to me. As soon as they hear of me, they will obey me.

22.zh: 外邦人要衰残， 战战兢兢地出他们的营寨。
22.en: The foreigners will fade away, and will come trembling out of their close places.

22.zh: 耶和华是活神，愿我的磐石被人称颂！ 愿　神—那拯救我的磐石被人尊崇！
22.en: The LORD lives! Blessed be my rock! Exalted be God, the rock of my salvation,

22.zh: 这位　神就是那为我伸冤、 使众民服在我以下的。
22.en: even the God who executes vengeance for me, who brings down peoples under me,

22.zh: 你救我脱离仇敌， 又把我举起，高过那些起来攻击我的； 你救我脱离强暴的人。
22.en: who brings me away from my enemies. Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man.

22.zh: 耶和华啊，因此我要在外邦中称谢你， 歌颂你的名。
22.en: Therefore I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.

22.zh: 耶和华赐极大的救恩给他[所立]的王， 施慈爱给他的受膏者， 就是给大卫和他的后裔， 直到永远！
22.en: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, forever more.”

23.zh: 以下是大卫末了的话。耶西的儿子大卫得居高位，是雅各　神所膏的，作以色列的美歌者，说：
23.en: Now these are the last words of David. David the son of Jesse says, the man who was raised on high says, the anointed of the God of Jacob, the sweet psalmist of Israel:

23.zh: 耶和华的灵借着我说： 他的话在我口中。
23.en: “The LORD’s Spirit spoke by me. His word was on my tongue.

23.zh: 以色列的　神、 以色列的磐石晓谕我说： 那以公义治理人民的， 敬畏　神执掌权柄，
23.en: The God of Israel said, the Rock of Israel spoke to me, ‘One who rules over men righteously, who rules in the fear of God,

23.zh: 他必像日出的晨光， 如无云的清晨， 雨后的晴光， 使地[发生]嫩草。
23.en: shall be as the light of the morning when the sun rises, a morning without clouds, when the tender grass springs out of the earth, through clear shining after rain.’

23.zh: 我家在　神面前并非如此； 　神却与我立永远的约。 这约凡事坚稳， 关乎我的一切救恩和我一切所想望的， 他岂不为我成就吗？
23.en: Isn’t my house so with God? Yet he has made with me an everlasting covenant, ordered in all things, and sure, for it is all my salvation and all my desire. Won’t he make it grow?

23.zh: 但匪类都必像荆棘被丢弃； 人不敢用手拿它；
23.en: But all the ungodly will be as thorns to be thrust away, because they can’t be taken with the hand.

23.zh: 拿它的人必带铁器和枪杆， 终久它必被火焚烧。
23.en: The man who touches them must be armed with iron and the staff of a spear. They will be utterly burned with fire in their place.”

23.zh: 大卫勇士的名字记在下面：他革扪人约设·巴设，又称伊斯尼人亚底挪，他是军长的统领，一时击杀了八百人。
23.en: These are the names of the mighty men whom David had: Josheb Basshebeth, a Tahchemonite, chief of the captains; he was called Adino the Eznite, who killed eight hundred at one time.

23.zh: 其次是亚合人朵多的儿子以利亚撒。从前非利士人聚集要打仗，以色列人迎着上去，有跟随大卫的三个勇士向非利士人骂阵，其中有以利亚撒。
23.en: After him was Eleazar the son of Dodai the son of an Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with David when they defied the Philistines who were there gathered together to battle, and the men of Israel had gone away.

23.zh: 他起来击杀非利士人，直到手臂疲乏，手黏住刀把。那日耶和华使[以色列]人大获全胜；众民在以利亚撒后头专夺财物。
23.en: He arose and struck the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand froze to the sword; and the LORD worked a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to take plunder.

23.zh: 其次是哈拉人亚基的儿子沙玛。一日，非利士人聚集成群，在一块长满红豆的田里，众民就在非利士人面前逃跑。
23.en: After him was Shammah the son of Agee, a Hararite. The Philistines had gathered together into a troop where there was a plot of ground full of lentils; and the people fled from the Philistines.

23.zh: 沙玛却站在那田间击杀非利士人，救护了那田。耶和华使[以色列]人大获全胜。
23.en: But he stood in the middle of the plot and defended it, and killed the Philistines; and the LORD worked a great victory.

23.zh: 收割的时候，有三十个勇士中的三个人下到亚杜兰洞见大卫。非利士的军兵在利乏音谷安营。
23.en: Three of the thirty chief men went down, and came to David in the harvest time to the cave of Adullam; and the troop of the Philistines was encamped in the valley of Rephaim.

23.zh: 那时大卫在山寨，非利士人的防营在伯利恒。
23.en: David was then in the stronghold; and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Bethlehem.

23.zh: 大卫渴想，说：「甚愿有人将伯利恒城门旁、井里的水打来给我喝。」
23.en: David said longingly, “Oh that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!”

23.zh: 这三个勇士就闯过非利士人的营盘，从伯利恒城门旁的井里打水，拿来奉给大卫。他却不肯喝，将水奠在耶和华面前，
23.en: The three mighty men broke through the army of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem that was by the gate and took it and brought it to David; but he would not drink of it, but poured it out to the LORD.

23.zh: 说：「耶和华啊，这三个人冒死[去打水]；[这水]好像他们的血一般，我断不敢喝。」如此，大卫不肯喝。这是三个勇士所做的事。
23.en: He said, “Be it far from me, LORD, that I should do this! Isn’t this the blood of the men who risked their lives to go?” Therefore he would not drink it. The three mighty men did these things.

23.zh: 洗鲁雅的儿子、约押的兄弟亚比筛是这三个勇士的首领；他举枪杀了三百人，就在三个勇士里得了名。
23.en: Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief of the three. He lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them, and had a name among the three.

23.zh: 他在这三个勇士里是最尊贵的，所以作他们的首领，只是不及前三个勇士。
23.en: Wasn’t he most honorable of the three? Therefore he was made their captain. However he wasn’t included as one of the three.

23.zh: 有甲薛勇士耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅行过大能的事；他杀了摩押人亚利伊勒的两个儿子，又在下雪的时候下坑里去，杀了一个狮子，
23.en: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit in a time of snow.

23.zh: 又杀了一个强壮的埃及人；埃及人手里拿着枪，比拿雅只拿着棍子下去，从埃及人手里夺过枪来，用那枪将他杀死。
23.en: He killed a huge Egyptian, and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a staff and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear.

23.zh: 这是耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅所行的事，就在三个勇士里得了名。
23.en: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things, and had a name among the three mighty men.

23.zh: 他比那三十个勇士都尊贵，只是不及前三个勇士。大卫立他作护卫长。
23.en: He was more honorable than the thirty, but he didn’t attain to the three. David set him over his guard.

23.zh: 三十个勇士里有约押的兄弟亚撒黑，伯利恒人朵多的儿子伊勒哈难，
23.en: Asahel the brother of Joab was one of the thirty: Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,

23.zh: 哈律人沙玛，哈律人以利加，
23.en: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,

23.zh: 帕勒提人希利斯，提哥亚人益吉的儿子以拉，
23.en: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,

23.zh: 亚拿突人亚比以谢，户沙人米本乃，
23.en: Abiezer the Anathothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,

23.zh: 亚合人撒们，尼陀法人玛哈莱，
23.en: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,

23.zh: 尼陀法人巴拿的儿子希立，便雅悯族、基比亚人利拜的儿子以太，
23.en: Heleb the son of Baanah the Netophathite, Ittai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,

23.zh: 比拉顿人比拿雅，迦实溪人希太，
23.en: Benaiah a Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash.

23.zh: 伯·亚拉巴人亚比亚本，巴鲁米人押斯玛弗，
23.en: Abialbon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,

23.zh: 沙本人以利雅哈巴，雅善儿子中的约拿单，
23.en: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, the sons of Jashen, Jonathan,

23.zh: 哈拉人沙玛，哈拉人沙拉的儿子亚希暗，
23.en: Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam the son of Sharar the Ararite,

23.zh: 玛迦人亚哈拜的儿子以利法列，基罗人亚希多弗的儿子以连，
23.en: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maacathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,

23.zh: 迦密人希斯莱，亚巴人帕莱，
23.en: Hezro the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,

23.zh: 琐巴人拿单的儿子以甲，迦得人巴尼，
23.en: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,

23.zh: 亚扪人洗勒，比录人拿哈莱（是给洗鲁雅的儿子约押拿兵器的），
23.en: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, armor bearers to Joab the son of Zeruiah,

23.zh: 以帖人以拉，以帖人迦立，
23.en: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

23.zh: 赫人乌利亚，共有三十七人。
23.en: and Uriah the Hittite: thirty-seven in all.

24.zh: 耶和华又向以色列人发怒，就激动大卫，使他吩咐人去数点以色列人和犹大人。
24.en: Again the LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he moved David against them, saying, “Go, count Israel and Judah.”

24.zh: 大卫就吩咐跟随他的元帅约押说：「你去走遍以色列众支派，从但直到别是巴，数点百姓，我好知道他们的数目。」
24.en: The king said to Joab the captain of the army, who was with him, “Now go back and forth through all the tribes of Israel, from Dan even to Beersheba, and count the people, that I may know the sum of the people.”

24.zh: 约押对王说：「无论百姓多少，愿耶和华—你的　神再加增百倍，使我主我王亲眼得见。我主我王何必喜悦行这事呢？」
24.en: Joab said to the king, “Now may the LORD your God add to the people, however many they may be, one hundred times; and may the eyes of my lord the king see it. But why does my lord the king delight in this thing?”

24.zh: 但王的命令胜过约押和众军长。约押和众军长就从王面前出去，数点以色列的百姓。
24.en: Notwithstanding, the king’s word prevailed against Joab and against the captains of the army. Joab and the captains of the army went out from the presence of the king to count the people of Israel.

24.zh: 他们过了约旦河，在迦得谷中、城的右边亚罗珥安营，与雅谢相对，
24.en: They passed over the Jordan and encamped in Aroer, on the right side of the city that is in the middle of the valley of Gad, and to Jazer;

24.zh: 又到了基列和他停·合示地，又到了但·雅安，绕到西顿，
24.en: then they came to Gilead and to the land of Tahtim Hodshi; and they came to Dan Jaan and around to Sidon,

24.zh: 来到泰尔的保障，并希未人和迦南人的各城，又到犹大南方的别是巴。
24.en: and came to the stronghold of Tyre, and to all the cities of the Hivites and of the Canaanites; and they went out to the south of Judah, at Beersheba.

24.zh: 他们走遍全地，过了九个月零二十天，就回到耶路撒冷。
24.en: So when they had gone back and forth through all the land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.

24.zh: 约押将百姓的总数奏告于王：以色列拿刀的勇士有八十万；犹大有五十万。
24.en: Joab gave up the sum of the counting of the people to the king; and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men who drew the sword, and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men.

24.zh: 大卫数点百姓以后，就心中自责，祷告耶和华说：「我行这事大有罪了。耶和华啊，求你除掉仆人的罪孽，因我所行的甚是愚昧。」
24.en: David’s heart struck him after he had counted the people. David said to the LORD, “I have sinned greatly in that which I have done. But now, the LORD, put away, I beg you, the iniquity of your servant; for I have done very foolishly.”

24.zh: 大卫早晨起来，耶和华的话临到先知迦得，就是大卫的先见，说：
24.en: When David rose up in the morning, the LORD’s word came to the prophet Gad, David’s seer, saying,

24.zh: 「你去告诉大卫，说耶和华如此说：『我有三样灾，随你选择一样，我好降与你。』」
24.en: “Go and speak to David, ‘The LORD says, “I offer you three things. Choose one of them, that I may do it to you.”’”

24.zh: 于是迦得来见大卫，对他说：「你愿意国中有七年的饥荒呢？是在你敌人面前逃跑，被追赶三个月呢？是在你国中有三日的瘟疫呢？现在你要揣摩思想，我好回复那差我来的。」
24.en: So Gad came to David, and told him, saying, “Shall seven years of famine come to you in your land? Or will you flee three months before your foes while they pursue you? Or shall there be three days’ pestilence in your land? Now answer, and consider what answer I shall return to him who sent me.”

24.zh: 大卫对迦得说：「我甚为难！我愿落在耶和华的手里，因为他有丰盛的怜悯。我不愿落在人的手里。」
24.en: David said to Gad, “I am in distress. Let us fall now into the LORD’s hand, for his mercies are great. Let me not fall into man’s hand.”

24.zh: 于是，耶和华降瘟疫与以色列人，自早晨到所定的时候；从但直到别是巴，民间死了七万人。
24.en: So the LORD sent a pestilence on Israel from the morning even to the appointed time; and seventy thousand men died of the people from Dan even to Beersheba.

24.zh: 天使向耶路撒冷伸手要灭城的时候，耶和华后悔，就不降这灾了，吩咐灭民的天使说：「够了！住手吧！」那时耶和华的使者在耶布斯人亚劳拿的禾场那里。
24.en: When the angel stretched out his hand toward Jerusalem to destroy it, the LORD relented of the disaster, and said to the angel who destroyed the people, “It is enough. Now withdraw your hand.” The LORD’s angel was by the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.

24.zh: 大卫看见灭民的天使，就祷告耶和华说：「我犯了罪，行了恶；但这群羊做了什么呢？愿你的手攻击我和我的父家。」
24.en: David spoke to the LORD when he saw the angel who struck the people, and said, “Behold, I have sinned, and I have done perversely; but these sheep, what have they done? Please let your hand be against me, and against my father’s house.”

24.zh: 当日，迦得来见大卫，对他说：「你上去，在耶布斯人亚劳拿的禾场上为耶和华筑一座坛。」
24.en: Gad came that day to David and said to him, “Go up, build an altar to the LORD on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.”

24.zh: 大卫就照着迦得奉耶和华名所说的话上去了。
24.en: David went up according to the saying of Gad, as the LORD commanded.

24.zh: 亚劳拿观看，见王和他臣仆前来，就迎接出去，脸伏于地，向王下拜，
24.en: Araunah looked out, and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him. Then Araunah went out and bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.

24.zh: 说：「我主我王为何来到仆人这里呢？」大卫说：「我要买你这禾场，为耶和华筑一座坛，使民间的瘟疫止住。」
24.en: Araunah said, “Why has my lord the king come to his servant?” David said, “To buy your threshing floor, to build an altar to the LORD, that the plague may be stopped from afflicting the people.”

24.zh: 亚劳拿对大卫说：「我主我王，你喜悦用什么，就拿去献祭。看哪，这里有牛可以作燔祭，有打粮的器具和套牛的轭可以当柴烧。
24.en: Araunah said to David, “Let my lord the king take and offer up what seems good to him. Behold, the cattle for the burnt offering, and the threshing sledges and the yokes of the oxen for the wood.

24.zh: 王啊，这一切，我亚劳拿都奉给你」；又对王说：「愿耶和华—你的　神悦纳你。」
24.en: All this, O king, does Araunah give to the king.” Araunah said to the king, “May the LORD your God accept you.”

24.zh: 王对亚劳拿说：「不然。我必要按着价值向你买；我不肯用白得之物作燔祭献给耶和华—我的　神。」大卫就用五十舍客勒银子买了那禾场与牛。
24.en: The king said to Araunah, “No, but I will most certainly buy it from you for a price. I will not offer burnt offerings to the LORD my God which cost me nothing.” So David bought the threshing floor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.

24.zh: 大卫在那里为耶和华筑了一座坛，献燔祭和平安祭。如此，耶和华垂听国民所求的，瘟疫在以色列人中就止住了。
24.en: David built an altar to the LORD there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. So the LORD was entreated for the land, and the plague was removed from Israel.
